Description: Publisher's description: If you're tired of the same old fantasy world where everybody knows all the races, all the monsters, and all the magics, then these books are what you've been looking for! All fully described in Citybook style. Discover the world of Lejentia. LEJENTIA CAMPAIGNS BOOK 1: Skully's Harbor contains a fully described and mapped town, world map, over 50 NPCs, & 75 different scenarios. Plus, the first 40 pages of the book describe new races, magic spells, and a detailed description of the culture and religions of this unique world.

Name: Wild West Weapon Data Supplement
Description: From the back cover: Now the Phoenix Command Small Arms Combat System lets you ride with the soldiers and gunslingers of the American Frontier. This supplement features 48 of the most popular and memorable weapons of the West, as well as special rules for the classic shootouts of legend. Included are: - Pistols, from the Derringer to the Colt Peacemaker - Muskets, from the Charleville to the Springfield 1863 - Breechloading Rifles, from the Sharps Carbine to the Springfield 1873 - Lever Action Rifles, from the Henry Repeater to the Winchester 1873 - Other Weapons, including the Sawed-Off Shotgun and the Gatling Gun Also included are sections on Quick Drawing, Fanning Revolvers, Speed Loading, and rules for Firing From (and Firing At) Horses, as well as an overview of weapons development through the nineteenth century. Fully illustrated, this supplement allows Phoenix Command players to include the Napoleonic Era, the Civil War, and the days of the American Frontier in their gaming.

Name: More Songs About Food Vats
Description: From back cover: Attention Troubleshooters Treasonous elements in our society have discovered a potentially dangerous biochemical supplement which they wish to introduce into our food supplies. They call it Af-ro-dee-see-ak. Its effects are unknown. Your mission, whether you like it or not, is to guard the food vats from sabotage while preserving the machinery and personnel in the food vat area. You will have no trouble accomplishing this mission - The Computer says so. One final, unimportant note: please sign all Release From Damages and Pre-Treason Execution Vouchers before reporting for your briefing. Thank you for your cooperation.

Name: NAIS The Fourth Succession War Military Atlas Volume 2
Description: From the back of the book: "100,000,000 Dead. 600,000,000 Injured. 800,000,000 C-Bills worth of property destroyed. The Fourth Succession War - so brilliantly planned, so perfectly executed, and so dramatically announced, has become far more than Hanse Davion ever anticipated. The battles continue, and the toll is huge, the highest in almost 100 years. Here is told, in strategic terms, the history of the war from January 3029 to January 3030. The campaigns, the tactics, and the battles themselves, compiled from reports by the commanders and MechWarriors who fought them. Learn the planets that changed hands, and why. Full-color maps depict the movement of forces, battlefield terrain, and the cities and other objectives they fought for. BattleForce statistics are included for 50 key regiments, such as the Genyosha and the Kell Hounds. Hundreds of BattleTech engagements can be generated from these stats using a simple conversion table."

Name: Mystic Masters
Description: From the back of the book: Join the ranks of superheroic magicians in this spellbinding 112-page volume! Mystic Masters tells you how to create your own powerful master of mysticism! Only you and your powerful fellow players stand against a host of magical supervillains: the alien sorcerer Jarth, the Vandaleur family of wizards, and the indomitable Tyrannon the Conquerer! Inside you'll find campaign guidelines for designing other dimensions and developing your own comic book magic system.

Name: Referee's Gaming Kit
Description: Referee's Gaming Kit is a supplement for MegaTraveller. This kit of accessory items includes: A 4 page Guide with hints, tips, a guide to equipment sheets, and a blank sheet. A Referee's Screen that consolidates important tables. A set of 8 equipment data sheets 2 folio adventures

Name: Dark Continents
Description: Dark Continents is a sourcebook providing background and adventures set in a colonial genre during England's period of foreign colonization of Africa. The information includes both historical and supernatural elements. Intended as a supplement for To Challenge Tomorrow, the publisher also advertised it as compatible with Call of Cthulhu, GURPS, and Hero System. This item won the 1990 Sigma Award for Best RPG Aid. The sourcebook was reprinted at least once in 1992.

Name: Tales of the Loremasters Book II
Description: From the back of the book: A demon-warrior prowls a seacoast, a proud and wily Sphinx guards gold and jewels hidden beneath desert ruins, a mysterious meteorite rests uneasily on the barren tundra -- these adventure sites and many more will entice daring rogues to travel northern Kulthea in search of treasure and challenge. Battle a Basilisk for a chest of precious stones, or duel a barbaric warrior who can pluck out your eye with his whip. On Jaiman, home-continent of the Cloudlords, a usurping Potentate and his army of thugs must be overthrown. Is the reward offered by the oppressed mountain folk of Forvers worth risking life and limb? Once "Under the Sword" of oppression, only you and your party of adventurers can decide! Tales of the Loremasters, Book II includes: * 10 different adventure scenarios for various levels under one cover! * Maps and views of a mountain town under siege, haunted desert ruins, an underground complex, an arctic wasteland, and a mysterious meteorite on the barren tundra of northern Jaiman. * Stats for Rolemaster and Fantasy Hero, including a Master NPC Table and a Beast Chart. * A detailed map of a mountainous region of northern Jaiman, where the town of Forvers lies under siege and is the site of an extended adventure, "Under the Sword"

Name: L'Affaire des Faux Menhirs
Description: 'The Menhir Forger' This is not a normal Asterix comic. In this comic you play the hero Grautvornix and you have to decide which way the adventure will take! A solo adventure in the world of Asterix. Everything you need is included.

Name: Tome of the Ancient and Esoteric Mysteries of the Powers of Peleahn
Description: The Tome of the Ancient and Esoteric Mysteries of the Powers of Peleahn presents 24 spells of Peleahn, mainly dealing with the element of fire.

Name: GURPS Conan: The Wyrmslayer
Description: "Solo Adventure in Robert E. Howard's Hyborian Age" Third GURPS Conan solo adventure.

Name: The Cyclopedia Talislanta: The Western Lands (Volume IV)
Description: "The Western Lands contain wonder and danger enough to intrigue the most jaded adventurer. Who are the mysterious Revenants, and how many one be protected from them? What secrets do the nomadic Sarista keep? What terrors (and treasures) lurk in the hidden depths of Werewood? And what of Zandu and Aaman? Who will be victorious in this year's Clash of Champions? Will the Cult Wars ever resume, and will there be a final victor? Do the Aamanian pilgrims who travel across Talislanta have a hidden motive? Will the chaos of Zandu eventually lead to that nation's collapse into bickering factions? These and many other questions may be answered by adventurers brave or foolhardy enough to visit the Western Lands of Talislanta.

Name: Out of the Mists
Description: From the back of the book "In the mysterious forests of Altair... the climate is MURDER. Explore the planet and make contact with the 'friendly' natives - a simple mission with a simple objective. But the cold-blooded murder of the mission commander has complicated matters thoroughly. You and your fellow Justifiers must find the killer... ... before he finds you."

Name: The Sting of the Spider
Description: From the back coverBegin Communication TO: All agents in all bureaus FROM: Orion Foundation RE: San Cristobal Base Once called a "glittering island jewel", the beautiful resort of San Cristobal has begun to show more cracks. The establishment of an Orion Foundation Operations center on the island has proceeded smoothly—but no one suspected that the new center would see so much business, so soon! But indications of grave trouble have been increasingly common on the island. Not only have the usual nefarious perpetrators of revolution, piracy, and smuggling gained strength and influence there, but now ruthless agents of the Web have established themselves on San Cristobal. Their work is urgent, though the Web's objectives on the island remain unknown. Are they working in concert with the Russians? The Cubans? Perhaps the CIA? The Sting of the Spider is the sequel to Web of Deceit, the module that introduced players and Administrators to San Cristobal. This module is designed to expand the adventure on the island and answer some important questions. Though it is designed especially for Orion Agents, representatives of other agencies will have little trouble adapting the module to their campaigns - there's plenty of danger to go around! End Communication

Name: Autoduel America
Description: From published material Looking for adventure? Trouble? A route across the bandit-ravaged countryside of America, 2039? Or just a safe truck stop? Autoduel America puts the world of 2039 right at your fingertips. Two beautiful 23" x 35" full-color maps detail the North American continent, including road conditions for the major interstate, U.S., and state highways; nuclear zones; truck stops; cities; fortress towns; ruins; military bases; national forests and parks; state and national capitals; no dueling zones and lawless areas. Use them as posters or as game aids for Car Wars or GURPS Autoduel campaigns.

Name: Advanced Phantasm Adventures Gamemaster's Handbook
Description: Author Summary: Phantasm Adventures contained sixty playable races, forty classes, a unique social system, and a magic system that allowed for more than twelve hundred different kinds of magic casters.

Name: Technical Readout: 2750
Description: From the back of the book: "In the year 2750, humanity was in the midst of a golden age. United under the interstellar government of the Star League, all mankind prospered and enjoyed an improved quality of life made possible by advances in technology, commerce, human rights, and the arts. Humanity had truly inherited the stars. But those same advances also carried a curse, for the engines of war from the Star League era possessed power unequalled in the Successor States today. BattleTech Technical Readout: 2750 provides illustrations, statistics, and other vital information about the BattleMechs, AeroSpace Fighters, Tanks and Hovercraft, Personal Equipment, and combat JumpShips of the Star League."

Name: Journey to the Magic Isle
Description: From the back cover Journey to the Magic Isle carries you by ship or magic to Uman, a remote island near a treacherous Essence Flow, where powers can be drained or doubled in an instant. High above the black beaches and deep woods juts an extinct volcano. Within its flooded cone lies a mysterious island, hidden from the world by the mists and the magic of an ancient lake, known as the Hidden Tarn. Only a few determined travelers have ever reached a rumored retreat for high-level magic users on this overgrown mystical isle. Here, Master Sorcerers and Mages summon and control the most powerful forces known to man. Yet Balizaar the Lich, back from the dead with a thirst for revenge, threatens to destroy the idyllic University of Magical Arts and the Master Magicians and Clerics with it. Can you outsmart or overpower the fallen undead spirit? Sail into Shadow World, a planet largely unexplored and undisturbed by the hand of man. Ascend the uncertain, jagged slopes of Uman in search of a hidden, magical realm! Journey to the Magic Isle includes: * Complete Descriptions of the University of Magical Arts, the Magic Isle, the Hidden Tarn, and Uman Island. * 7 Area Maps and Views covering all of Uman Island. * 6 Detailed Adventure locations. * 27 Masters of Magic: fully developed characters complete with Rolemaster and Fantasy Hero stats. * 14 Ready-to-Play NPC’s. Plus, by using the Aftermath sections in this module, Gamemasters can continue gaming on the Magic Isle, creating a rich endless campaign setting.

Name: Lone Wolf: The Fortress of Doom
Description: From the promotional material: Are you brave enough to explore this sinister fortress? Can you outwit the creatures of evil who haunt its halls and deadly dungeons? In this fantastic telephone adventure game by Joe Dever, you will become LONE WOLF, the last Kai Lord of Sommerland. Armed with your trusty sword and powerful Kai disciplines, you must strive to find the ancient Lorestone. Will you emerge triumphant? Or will you succumb to the terrors that stalk this dread fortress? To begin your quest, just phone the number below. listen to the narrator. Choose your actions by speaking to our unique voice-activated computer. Hidden prizes await all who triumph.

Name: GURPS Update
Description: "Basic Set Rule Changes from the Second Edition to the Third Edition" This 80-page book was maybe the most unusual book in the whole GURPS line. It was also one of the most useful. From the forward: "... when the Third Edition of the GURPS Basic Set came out, it was a massive revision. There were far too many changes for a simple revision sheet. ... "Therefore, this Update. It compiles, as best we were able to judge, all the significant rules changes, additions and deletions between the Second Edition and the Third." It also contained material to update GURPS Japan, Space, Humanx and Horror to Third edition as well. Finally, it contained all the changes that were made in GURPS Magic that superseded the first printing of GURPS Third Edition so that Update even served as an upgrade to the first printing of GURPS Third Edition! One thing lacking from it was the usually copious artist credits. There's art, but none of it's credited, though all of it appeared in previous GURPS publications.

Name: Wares Blade Starter Set
Description: Translated Title- Robot Fantasy RPG Wares Blade Start Set Basic boxed set includes a rule book, players guide, 3 10-sided dice, a sheet of stand-up figures, record sheets, and scenario book including the introductory adventure "The Mountain of the sleeping Demon" and advice for running the adventure. The contents of the set ◆ Player guide (48 pages) ◆ Rulebook(48 pages) ◆ Scenario Pack (56 pages) ◆ Character sheets 1 ◆ Character sheets 2 ◆ Magic sheets ◆ Machine Soldier sheets ◆ NPC sheets ◆ Fold-up Character counter ◆ 10 sided-dice (three)

Name: GURPS Supers School of Hard Knocks
Description: "Invasion of the Super-Teens" From the back of the book: "High school – a time for proms, football and homework. But at Knox High, it's also time for some of the students to try out there new super abilities! They're powerful, confused, and misunderstood. They create destruction and chaos wherever they go. They're hunted by the authorities ... and by dark powers."

Name: Lejentia Campaigns Book Two: Fort Bevits
Description: Subtitled: Adventures on the Dark Side of the River Styrmm Filled with villains, dark elves, and insectoid alien creatures called Novilles, Fort Bevits is a fully described fortress and caverns, with over 50 illustrated NPCs, 71 detailed scenarios, and over 20 maps of the fort and surrounding territory. Plus a 40-page intro section which details the politics, powers and culture of the Tarin Tor army. --publisher's description

Name: Der Bund der schwarzen Schlange
Description: Translated from the back: The long and dangerous journey through the southern seas is coming to an end. Finally the heroes will have a chance to confront their real opponents and to get even with them ...

Name: More Tales From the Ether
Description: A collection of four adventures set on Mars and Venus and some rules for combat between boats. This is the second adventure anthology for Space: 1889 and contains the complete, ready-to-run adventures: Caught in the Mire. An expedition for H. M. government leads you to the city of Thalia, where a British delegation attempts to mediate a settlement to a local war. What starts out as a routine trip becomes a nightmare, however, when swamp pirates decide to throw a monkey wrench into the negotiating machinery. The Lurker in the Moor. The botanist Dr. Van Warren lost his life in the search for knowledge. His daughter needs your help to secure his everlasting fame by bringing back specimens of a rare and extremely beautiful orchid from the depths of the Mylomeroen Swamp. The swamp is filled with dangers, however: Hill Martian pirates, deadly animals, nearly impassible terrain, and--worst of all--the lurker. Madness in the Moab. Dr. Fairbanks and an assistant are long overdue from their expedition into the trackless wastes of the Moab, and a reward of 500 pounds has been offered for news of the doctor's fate. The question is, is it worth 500 pounds to travel into the Moab? The Mystery of Fort Dickerson. The garrison of remote Fort Dickerson has been massacred, and the fort's civilians are missing. The main clue is an enigmatic message, the word "Seleti" painted on the wall--in blood.

Name: The Art of the Advanced Dungeons & Dragons Fantasy Game
Description: The Art of the Advanced Dungeons & Dragons Fantasy Game

Name: Quellbourne: Land of the Silver Mist
Description: From the back cover: Set sail for the land of the silver Mist, where treasure and undead alike rest uneasily in the ruins of Quellbourne's capital city, Quellburn. Overcome by the forces of the Unlife centuries before, the rugged Mannish population of this fog-swept land struggles to survive, battling pirate bands of Ice Krals and raiding Trolls, as they mine for gold and silver. Fortune hunters will find Quellbourne bountiful, if they can avoid being sacrificed to the Spider Goddess, Hrassk. Equally fatal are the Destroyers of Galtoth, a cult of men dedicated to destroying everything -- even the island they live on! Riches and tales too fabulous to be believed lure adventurers to Quellbourne's battered coast. The bold may find a map leading to an "abandoned?" silver mine, now home to denizens best left undisturbed. After outfiting themselves on the brawling streets of Kelfour's Landing, fortune-seekers might prowl the ruins of Quellburn, uncovering centuries of gold and booty. Or sail to Trelkinaark to challenge the formidable and plunder-laden Krals in their homeland. Quellbourne provides a complete fantasy campaign environment, including: * 2-page color map of Kelfour's Landing. * View and Room-by-room Layouts of Quellburn's Armory, Citadel of Wizards, Palace and more. * 8 detailed adventures.

Name: Star Crown Empire and the Sea of Fates
Description: From the back cover On the vast and rugged continent of Govon is G'thal, an ancient realm harboring a myriad of wary and volatile races, cultures and creatures. Known to adventurers as the Star Crown Empire, G'thal is composed of desert jungle, mountain and fertile plain. The Empire is home to haughty Elves, mean-spirited Dwarves, short-tempered Centaurs, suspicious Lizardmen of the swamps and thousands of Humans. The eight city-states of G'thal weave tenuous webs of intrigue and alliance, ever fearful of the warlike Trolls, Nomads and inhuman Hordes lurking on their troubled borders. Setting out from Borbinak, a trading town in the heart of the Empire, you can scour the Bola Wastes for gold and booty or head north to the mountains in search of treasure, trouble , and Trolls. As a change of pace, seaworthy adventurers can set sail for Lebyn, a fabled isle where immortality may be for sale.One thing is certain: death is cheaper! Welcome in G'thal! May your travels within the Star Crown Empire be as prosperous and exciting as a pirate's raid upon the Sea of Fates! The Star Crown Empire includes: * 8 Adventure Scenarios. * 3 In-depth Adventure locations: powerful Mage's castle, a bandits' hideout, and an island where Lizardmen and Pirates prowl the rocky shores and turbulent waters in search of bounty and blood. * 4 Pages of Full-color Maps. * Additional Maps of the lands and waters of the Star Crown Empire * Detailed View of Borbinak, a trading town where everything is for sale. * Descriptions of the History, Rulers, Wars and Wealth that make G'thal a land as real as our own, and ten times more dangerous. * Complete Fantasy Hero and Rolemaster Stats and Tables for all NPCs, creatures, Encounters and more!

Name: The Cyclopedia Talislanta: The Eastern Lands (Volume V)
Description: [from the Overview on p3] Eastern Talislanta is a place of danger and barbaric splendor, its fabled riches and mysteries drawing adventurers from across the continent. A few find their fortune. Others find terror and horrifying death. The East includes the barren steppes of the Greylands, the chill mountains of Xanadas, the lush jungles of Chana, and other extremes of terrain. Much of it is unexplored, and home to dangerous predators and hostile sentients.

Name: Kiraz: The Lost City
Description: From the cover - "Kiraz, the golden city, birthing bed of the Harnic Khuzdul. For seven thousand years Kiraz was the largest and richest city of Harn. The dwarves made her well, and she endured the coming of men, their haste and pestilence, their greed and wars. Until, that is, the tyranny of Lothrim, the Foulspawner. Now gloom hangs like a shroud about Kiraz, sealed with enchantment and good stone. Her dark and cavernous, haunted halls, seem yet to ring with the muted sounds of hammers no hand has touched for six centuries. Even the woods echo with the voices of a hundred ghosts. Now and then, an adventurer grown brave from too much ale, and greedy from tales of treasure, comes to Kiraz. If he is not enslaved or slain by the Equani or gargun, he will try the Gate of Hrazadar, seek other entrances, give up in disgust, and return whence he came - if he is lucky. Ushet The hills surrounding Kiraz are home to numerous bands of ores. There is a major gargun colony at Ushet, a cave-complex just four leagues southeast of the Kiraz. Ushet is inhabited by a hybrid culture of Gargu-Khanu, and their Gargu-Arak and Gargu-Hyeka slaves. The Khanu, also known as black orcs, are the largest, strongest, and most murderous of the five gargun species. The Horns of Ikarus Kiraz is also the scene of the second quest in the epic search for the mysterious, otherworld, arch-mage, Panaga. In the first quest, The Staff of Fanon, players were introduced to Panaga's misdeeds; in this quest they will come to realize that he is their nemesis. Compatible for all rule systems."

Name: Journeyman
Description: This is the rulebook for Journeyman, a hard sci-fi RPG that primarily uses 10 sided dice. Skill checks are made by adding a die roll to your relevant skill value. Classes or professions determine your starting skills and equipment only. The rulebook includes stats and descriptions for various alien races and tables for randomly generating planets or entire solar systems. Also included in a section on space travel are equations pertaining to the theory of special relativity.

Name: Monsters of Myth and Legend II
Description: From cover: Monsters of Myth and Legend II, the companion volume to Monsters of Myth and Legend, is a must for anyone who has ever wanted to adventure in exotic lands around the world. Whether you have an avid interest in the legends, lore, and tales of different countries, or you want to add variety and intrigue to your campaign or adventure, Monsters of Myth and Legend II is an outstanding work to add to your fantasy role-playing library. This sourcebook features details of mythological beings from the ancient cultures of: Africa Central and South America The Eskimos Japan The Middle East Each description in this compendium contains statistics and detailed background of the being and the myth on which it is based, as well as all appropriate game-related information to complete your campaign setting. Also included is a listing of special items and new spells which can be used to further enhance your adventuring experiences in faraway lands.

Name: Liebliche Prinzessin Yasmina
Description: Translated from the back: It seems to be the special fate of beautiful princesses to be abducted from time to time. On the other hand such a sad destiny inevitable calls upon a courageous rescuer, which is you dear friend one of the last true heroes... Prepare yourself - not only with courage and your favourite sword but with humour as well! Else you will hardly stick out this adventure!

Name: Middle-earth Role Playing Combat Screen and Reference Sheets (1st edition, revised)
Description: From the back: The MIDDLE-EARTH Role Playing COMBAT SCREEN™ is a must for all MERP gamers! Included are all the MERP tables needed for battles, maneuvering and action on one 34″ × 11″ combat screen plus two 17″ × 11″ reference sheets.

Name: Dungeon Masters Assistant Volume II: Characters & Treasures
Description: Publisher Blurb DUNGEON MASTERS ASSISTANT, Volume II: CHARACTERS & TREASURES is SSI's latest time saver for Dungeon Masters (DMs). No longer is it necessary to spend hours populating a town or generating player characters or henchmen. Speed up your game immeasurably by generating detailed player or non-player characters, and large treasure hoards, in moments! Every facet of character generation, from languages and spell lists to class and racial abilities, is accounted for. All character classes, including multi-class characters, can be rolled up in a snap and will appear on ready-made character sheets with all the pertinent information ready to use. You can even print these sheets for instant use. All magic items from the AD&D Dungeon Masters Guide (AD&D 1e) and Unearthed Arcana, plus all treasure types from the Monster Manual (AD&D 1e) and Monster Manual II (AD&D 1e), can be generated with this powerful program. By letting the computer do most of the number-crunching work, such time consuming chores as creating large numbers of gems, jewelry, or intelligent weapons become simple tasks. Harness the power of the computer with this versatile utility - spend less time in preparation and more time enjoying AD&D game play.

Name: Calandia Guidebook
Description: From box cover: The continent of calandia, home to the City-State of the Invincible Overlord, is an intricately knit tapestry of cultural, social, and political structures...an exciting backdrop for your fantasy role-playing campaigns.

Name: Die Magie des Schwarzen Auges
Description: From the back of the box: Die Magie des Schwarzen Auges: Magier, Schelm, Hexe, Druide und Elf - das sind die magiekundigen Helden, die mit ihren übernatürlichen Kräften Furcht und Schrecken unter Aventuriens Schurken und Ungeheuern verbreiten. In dieser Box finden Sie alles, was Sie über die magischen Kräfte und ihre Beherrscher wissen müssen. Sie erfahren worin sich die Schelmenmagie von der Macht der Druiden unterscheidet und daß es drei Elfenstämme mit einer Vielfalt unterschiedlicher Zauber gibt. Sie lernen die magische Bibliothek kennen und das Gildewesen der klassischen Schulmagie. Sie können miterleben, wie aus ihrem zaghaften Zauberlehrling im Verlaufe vieler Spielabende einer der mächtigen Großmeister der weißen, grauen oder schwarzen Künste wird. Translation: The magic of the Dark Eye: Mage, Rogue, Witch, Druid and Elf - these are the magic wielding heros who, with their supernatural powers, spread fear and terror among Aventurias villains and monsters. In this box you will find everything you need to know about the magic powers and their masters. You know what's the difference between a rogues magic and the power of the Druids, and that there are three elven tribes with a variety of different spells. You learn to know the magic library and the guild system of the classical school magic. You can experience how to turn your timid apprentice wizard in the course of many evenings into one of the powerful Grand Masters of the white, gray or black arts.

Name: Riimumestarin kirja laajennusosa RuneQuestiin
Description: from the book Laajennus RuneQuestiin Sisältö: - Uusia taistelusääntöjä - Uusia aseita, panssareita ja sotakoneita - Uusi taikuudenlaji: rituaalit - 47 loitsua - 52 uutta hirviötä ja olentoa - Dracoliskot Expansion to RuneQuest Inc. - New battlerules - New guns, armors and war machines - New magic; rituals - 47 new spells - 52 new monsters and creatures - Draconewts

Name: Im Reich des Frosthexers
Description: Publisher Blurb:Die Abenteurer haben erfahren, dass der Frosthexer im hohen Norden Waelands haust und segeln dorthin. Sie müssen sich den Weg zu ihm bahnen, vorbei an Wachen und Fallen, um zum Schluss zwischen dem Frosthexer und dem Baron von Deorstead zu vermitteln. Translation:The adventurers have learned that the Frost Warlock dwells in the far north of Waeland and sail there. They need to pave the way to him, past guards and traps, to mediate between the Frost Warlock and the Baron of Deorstead in the end.

Name: Advanced Phantasm Adventures Players Handbook
Description: Author Summary: Phantasm Adventures contained sixty playable races, forty classes, a unique social system, and a magic system that allowed for more than twelve hundred different kinds of magic casters.

Name: Saga 7: Neues aus Adramil
Description: user summary / from the back of the book Neues aus Adramil (News from Adramil) is a source book for SAGA. This book answers more question about the dragon cult, if there is a dragon at Nir... time table background maps and drawings NPCs adventure ideas (not only for SAGA)

Name: The Axon Confrontation
Description: An Introductory Justifiers Scenario From the introduction: The team will be beaming to the planet Axon, officially controlled and under exploration by TTMS. They will have to locate the stolen shuttle, then hunt down Major Martell and the rest of his team. Once found, the team must confront Martell and recover the stolen test data and prototype weapons, all the time attempting to avoid direct contact with TTMS.

Name: I Signori del Caos. Espansione al Gioco Base
Description: user summary The Lord of Chaos. Expansion to the Basic Game This is the first expansion for the Italian Role Playing Game "I Signori del Caos" Contents: Master screen Rulebook 3: Additions and Explications to the Game Rules Rulebook 4: Additions and Explications to Magic Updated Character sheets

Name: Les Divisions de l'Ombre
Description: Les divisions de l'ombre is a French RPG where players are mutant humans with superpowers, persecuted by oppressive governments and megacorporations in the near future (2030). They belong to a secret organization (les Division de l'Ombre) striving for freedom and fighting against threats to mankind.

Name: Gladiators of the Roman Empire
Description: From the introduction Your opponent falls! He's badly wounded! He can't continue! Yes! Habet! He holds his finger up in a plea for mercy! The choice is yours. Spare his life? Or finish him off? What would you do? User summary: This scenario of gladiatorial combat also was advertised as F.I.S.T.3. Players could either fight against the telephone opponent, Spartacus, or against another player (PvP). Combats allowed players to make periodic selections of fighting stance, aggressiveness, and attack options - by selecting from menu options on the telephone keypad.

Name: Metal Fantaisy
Description: Metal Fantaisy is the only additional material released for Whog Shrog beyond the core rulebook. It contains: New rules for adding robots in the game, and playing one A chapter discussing Loks (archenemies of the player characters), how to create them and what their powers are A description of a planetary system ("l'Archipel"), of the 34 planets that are part of it and their inhabitants Rules for drugs New artillery weapons 2 scenarios ("Santa la Chienne" and "Tropiques Blindés") taking place in the Archipel

Name: Stranded!
Description: YOU ARE STRANDED ON A DESERT ISLAND! You're on an ocean liner crossing the Pacific when a gigantic wave knocks you overboard.After several hours floating on a wooden crate, you land on the shores of a tropical island. You have no way to get home! You could explore the island, but you can't be sure what you will find. Perhaps you should stay where you are and hope to signal a passing ship. If you decide to stay where you are, turn to page 45. If you decide to go exploring, turn to page 36. But be careful! The island seems deserted, but there could be many dangers waiting for you! On the tropical island, you might come face-to-face with a roaring gorilla. Or you might find people there who will help you find a way home! What happens next while you are stranded depends on the choice you make. Some of your adventures will be scary, some will be exciting - but all of them will be fun! (back of book)

Name: Eilapam
Description: From the frontcover of the book (in Swedish): Eilapam - Äventyrens stad Den blomstrande handelsstaden mitt i Khelataar där bergs-, träsk- och skogsfolket lever tillsammans med khelataarerna. I Eilapams sjudande stadsliv finner du mörka gränder fyllda av ondska men också färgstarka värdshus där du kan ta del av alla intriger, hjältemod och äventyr som staden har att erbjuda. Må lyckan stå dig bi... User translation: Eilapam - City of Adventure The blooming trade city in the middle of Khelataar where the mountain people, swamp people and forrest people live together with the Khelataarians. In Eilapam, teeming with activity, you will find dark alleys filled with evil as well as colourful taverns where you can listen to all intrigues, valour and adventure that the city has to offer. May fortune favour you...

Name: Regelwerk
Description: The Regelwerk (rules volume) contains the character advancement rules, combat rules, and magic rules of Mächte, Mythen, Moddermonster. In addition to the Regelwerk, you also need the Charakterwerk (character volume) to play.

Name: TSR 1990 Product Catalogue
Description: From the introduction: Letter from the prosident The year 1989 has been a landmark year for TSR. In all of our product lines, we have seen tremendous success and growth. The launch of the AD&D 2nd Edition product line has recieved consumer acceptance far beyond our wildest dreams, and our book line has, according to LOCUS Magazine, reached a level of prominence second only to Ballantine/Del Rey/Fawcett. From a retail and manufacturing point of view, the expansion of the player base, and revitalizing of the marketplace bodes well for the new product in 1990. While this catalogue is a testament to the future, is is also an oppertunity to thank you for your efforts of the past. We at TSR do not hesistate to boast that 1990 will be geometrically more successful than our best year to date, 1989. Lorraine D. Williams President

Name: Tome of the Ancient and Esoteric Mysteries of the Phantasms of Lyahvi
Description: The Tome of the Ancient and Esoteric Mysteries of the Phantasms of Lyahvi presents 24 spells of Lyahvi, mainly dealing with illusions and the element of air.

Name: Star Strike Vessel Compendium #3: Imperial Ships
Description: This is an expansion for the board game Space Master: Star Strike and Space Master (1st & 2nd Editions). It includes stats for 25 different space vessels like fleet carriers, cruisers, destroyers, frigates, MMAC gunboats, TMAC fighters, SMAC fighters, survey/exploration vessels, transports, liners, freighters, scouts and orbital stations. Also included are 2 adventures for Space Master (1st & 2nd Editions), 11 mini-adventures for use with the included ships and 65 full-color counters. Adventures Agents of the ISI: A search and intrigue adventure for beginning characters of any Class. It would be helpful to have at least one character with expertise in Robotics and/or Cybernetics, and a Telepath or Semi-Telepath with abilities in the Field of Visions. Kidnapping of the Treasury Minister's Daughter: An adventure for mid to upper level Crime Techs, but other Techs, Armsmen, Pilots, and Telepaths are also helpful.

Name: You Are a Genius
Description: From publisher blurb: The reader has just finished graduate school at the age of 14 and must decide what to do with a genius-level IQ. Will the reader go into business and make a fortune or work for the government designing spaceships?

Name: Ironhedge Manifesto
Description: From the introduction: Complete Quantum Role Playing System Fun - Concise Ironhedge Rulebook Plus: 12 Character Cards & 6 Encounter Cards ... Ancient Fantasy Role Playing Adventure ... Ironhedge Manifesto ... Game of Swordfights, Thiefery, Magic, Treasure, Monsters, Power, & Lawlessness ... (Not For Idiots) User summary: Published Marne, MI, USA; $7.00 - includes cardstock-cover rulebook, 12 character cards, and 6 encounter cards

Name: Hintergrundwerk
Description: The Hintergrundwerk (background volume) describes the world of Meryllia. The first half of the book includes the history as well as descriptions of the lands, languages, religions, and diseases. The second half contains a bestiary and encounter tables.

Name: Domain of Xantree
Description: From cover of the book: The Domain of Xantree is a universal Fantasy Role-Playing Gaming (FRPG) adventures usable with most FRPG systems with little to no alterations

Name: Zimarakh
Description: From the frontcover of the book (in Swedish): Zimarakh - Gudarnas hem I århundraden har det mystiska bergets hemlighet förblivit dold. I Zimarakhs djupa valv och salar finns svaren på många hittills olösta gåtor. Men även gudarna kräver sin tribut... Translation: Zimarakh - Home of the Gods The secret of the mysterious mountain has been hidden for centuries. In Zimarakh's deep vaults and halls lie the answers to many as of yet unresolved riddles. But even the gods demand tribute...

Name: Projekt J.A.S
Description: User summary Projekt J.A.S is a universal/generic scenario that is set in 1980s Sweden. The characters are hired by the Swedish Security Service SÄPO to investigate an information leak about the development of the Swedish jet fighter JAS.

Name: The Tower
Description: From the back cover: Babylon's single continent is a wind swept plain. Here dwell dragons and mammoth spiders.. and a dozen other creatures to devour and destroy.. and if you survive Babylon there's still... The Tower.

Name: Die Erdenfeuer von Geredhar
Description: User summaryDie Erdenfeuer von Geredhar (The Earth Fires of Geredhar) is a German generic fantasy adventure. The player characters are sent to rediscover a long forgotten dwarven mine where the magical dragon crystals can be found.

Name: China: Why Was an Army Made of Clay?
Description: Publisher's blurb: As an Earth Inspector, the reader tries to solve the riddle of the army made of clay.

Name: Söhne des Lichts
Description: User summaryThis is the core book for the Söhne des Lichts RPG. It includes the game's rules and background material for the campaign world Mykrador. The book covers: Character creation and advancement Combat Magic Equipment A sample adventure Magic items Gods of Mykrador Mutations, diseases and alchemy Regions of Mykrador A bestiary

Name: Le Rendez-vous du Chef
Description: 'The Summit Conference' This is not a normal Asterix comic. In this comic you play the hero Grautvornix and you have to decide which way the adventure will take! A solo adventure in the world of Asterix. Everything you need is included.

Name: Keeper's Kit
Description: From the back cover of the included booklet: A Rugose Compendium of Squamous Stuff This packet contains essential play-aids for all Call of Cthulhu® players and keepers. A specially-constructed 8.5x33" colorful four-panel Keeper’s Screen featuring an additional 8.5x11" panel — instant access to important tables and rules from the Cthulhu game while minimizing play interference. A brand-new adventure, "The Dead-Man Stomp," was specially written for this package, and is suitable for both beginning and experienced players. Eight copies of the new, updated 1920s Character Sheet provide a convenient place for your players to summarize game data and are ready-to-use. The Monster Master, five copies of a new form on which the keeper can organize game data for his crazed cultists, maniac madmen, wicked wizards, and degenerate denizens of the Cthulhu Mythos. Each packet contains one of two different stickers, either a back-window university sticker for your car, or a "Go Pods!" bumper sticker proclaiming your loyalty to old M.U. A handy Miskatonic U. Note Pad, in a new style, provides a convenient spot for keepers to jot sinister ideas, devious plots and terrifying notes. A special Mythos Bookcover in one of three styles, either The Necronomicon, Cultes des Goules, or De Vermiis Mysteriis, can be used to protect your favorite haunting tome. A giant 20x27" Full-Cover Poster depicts a terrifying aspect of the Mythos. There are five different posters: Mansions of Madness, Cthulhu Classics, Masks of Nyarlathotep, Great Old Ones, and Arkham Unveiled, one in each kit. Collect them all!

Name: South Pole Sabotage
Description: From publisher blurb: On board the "Pole Star" to investigate ozone depletion over the South Pole, a series of decisions by the reader may mean the success or failure of the mission.

Name: Ysgarth Bestiary
Description: From the introduction: A Guide to creatures from the world of Ysgarth. [Includes] four dozen creatures, described and illustrated, plus a complete short adventure and more.

Name: Renegade Dreams
Description: From the back of the bookYou don't hear the constant drone of the street, or the blaring ads of the video billboards. You don't notice the garish colors of the street vendors, hawking everything from slapcaps to pirated senso reels. You don't smell the oxides and sulfides from the factories every time the wind shifts. Even the occasional gunshot is hardly worth a glance. If you heard it, it wasn't meant for you. You don't notice, because you live here, and it all fades to the background. What you do notice is that your credit is starting to wear a little thin, and you could use some work... So it begins. A simple interview from an electronic hiring board turns out to be more trouble than you expected, and you expected a lot, since the employer is AzBio, perhaps the most powerful megacorp on the planet. You should have guessed when you saw the reconstructive surgery option on the contract... As a bonus, Renegade Dreams also includes the full cyberspace rules for the SpaceTime universe, as well as background on how to intearate it into this and other adventures.

Name: Schimmen en Schaduwen Basisregelboek
Description: From the back cover (translated from Dutch): Dor is a world inhabited by strange races. Elves walk silently through the forests, dwarves delve for ore, giants live in the mountains and the seas are populated by scalings. Above all this lies the shadow of Rothin. It is quite an adventure to stay alive in this world. The heroes try to serve the powers of Good and foil Rothin in his attempts to control Dor. But his power is rising, and Dor needs heroes to stop him. 'Schimmen en Schaduwen' is an open game that can be played without a gameboard. Everything is driven by the imagination of the players and the gamesmaster. The possibilities are huge and are only limited by the imagination of the players. 'Schimmen en Schaduwen' is the roleplaying game of The Wise Tree and is not a translation from an English game, but an original game developed in Flanders. We hope to make Belgium and the Netherlands more independent w.r.t. roleplaying products. The Wise Tree will publish much more material in the near future. 'Schimmen en Schaduwen' contains a full guide to Dor, over 80 careers and professions, more than 90 skills, 40 monsters, 9 different magic classes and forms the basis of a lot of fun gaming!

Name: Mutiny in Space
Description: From publisher blurb: When a mutiny occurs on your space vessel, you need to choose which side you will fight for!

Name: Le Grand Jeu
Description: 'The Great Game' This is not a normal Asterix comic. In this comic you play the hero Grautvornix and you have to decide which way the adventure will take! A solo adventure in the world of Asterix. Everything you need is included.

Name: RuneQuest Games Master's Screen
Description: Description: Screen Master for the RuneQuest with all the rules tables. Along with the Screen is accompanied a book "The Lord of the Runes", a support for the Master Game. First Spanish edition by Joc Internacional 1989, second reprint 1992. Descripción: Pantalla del Director de RuneQuest con todas las tablas de reglas. Junto con la pantalla, le acompaña un libro bajo el título “El Señor de las Runas” que viene a ser una ayuda para el Director.

Name: Shoguns vrede
Description: From the back of the book (Swedish): "Samurajer!" Daimyons stämma var kraftfull som alltid och idag syntes han vara extra bister. "Jag har fått ett budskap från Shogunen. Det verkar som om en okänd organisation håller på att infiltrera den gruvverksamhet som pågår i vår provins. Detta är oacceptabelt både för shogunen och för mig. Därför får ni i uppdrag att omedelbart ta itu med detta. Ni får agera efter eget huvud och ni är bara ansvariga inför mig. Är det uppfattat?" Med en kort bugning visar du och dina kamrater att ni har förstått er feodalherre. Men vad är det som håller på att ske? Nara är en äventyrs- och kampanjmodul till Drakar och Demoner Samuraj. Den innehåller tre äventyr och en beskrivning av provinsen Nara och dess ledande invånare. User translation: Title: Wrath of the Shogun "Samurais!" The daimyo's voice was powerful as always and today he had an extra grim expression. "I have received a message from the shogun. It appears as if an unknown organization is infiltrating the mining activity in our provins. This is unacceptable both for the the shogun and for me. Therefor you are immediately assigned to deal with this. You will work on your own and report only to me. Do you understand?" With a quick bow you and your companions show that you have understood your fief lord. But what is it that is going on? Nara is an adventure and campaign module for Drakar och Demoner Samuraj. It contains three adventures and a description of the provins Nara and its prominent inhabitants.

Name: Nova Force
Description: High Adventure in the Year 8919 A science-fiction RPG set in the year 8919 that plays up high-tech characters and items like battlesuits.

Name: Omnigon
Description: From the back of the bookOnce again the fires of war burn throughout the galaxy. The Terran Empire has ruled over most of humanity for the last 100 years. Unlike earlier despotic governments the Empire makes no claims to be beneficial to the people it dominates. There are no illusions of equality, fairness, freedom, or prosperity; there is only obedience and suffering. To be a common citizen in the Terran Empire is to endure a life without hope, meet death alone, and to have ones lifeless body used to feed the countless multitude. But then you are not a common citizen. As a role player in the Omnigon universe, a player character is able to choose his character's race from a diverse group of alien beings (humans included). Each race is presented in a way which outlines that races innate "special" abilities. Also each race has a complete historical background and cultural belief system. Omnigon's system for player character skill development, character class definition, psionic usage, and combat are unique. These systems are easily understood and simple to manipulate. The vast weapon selection is highly detailed and allows the player to tailor the weapon to his needs. Omnigon is excellent for role-playing your favorite science fiction table top battle games. With a minimum of effort players can use Omnigon to recreate almost any future setting.

Name: Masques
Description: From the back of the book : You'll find in this book : - a complete guide of Venice - a description of the "Compagnons de Janus" - new player aids for Athanor RPG - a large campaign in Venice "Venise en 2306. Alors que les cérémonies du Boulier vont commencer, le carnaval bat son plein. Les Arlequins et les Colombines se pourchassent de passerelles en passerelles, au-dessus des ruelles inondées de la Cité des Doges. Autour de la Place Saint-Marc, des jeunes gens en costumes noir et blancs distribuent des tracts invitant à la communion universelle, tandis que discrètement on évacue de l'un des casinos une personne dont le coeur n'a pas résisté aux Simulateurs de réalité..."

Name: Raiders from the Frontier
Description: "Raiders from the Frontier: House Jade-London Besieged" is a Space Master Campaign Module and includes four adventures, governmental and historical background information, an encounter table, timelines, a list of definitions, and various maps and illustrations. Adventure in one of the Empire's wealthiest provinces.

Name: Science Fiction Players' Survival Kit
Description: This package is suited for use with Traveller™ and MegaTraveller™ by Game Designers Workshop, Inc. Inside the plastic bag the are multiple copies of the following sheets: MT01 Generic Character Form (Qty: 15) - Replacement character sheet designed with MegaTraveller in mind, but can be used with Traveller. MT02 Ship's Cargo Log (Qty: 10) - Used to keep track of cargo a ship buys and sells on its travels. MT03 Equipment/Vehicle Form (Qty: 5) - The front side is for listing group equipment. The back is for listing the stats of vehicles the characters may own.

Name: Master of the Game
Description: From the back cover: It is said that a role-playing game is only as good as its Game Master. Now there is a book especially designed and dedicated to this principal performer. Expertly written by renowned Grand Master Gary Gygax, Master of the Game guides Game Masters of all role-playing games in how to achieve their highest degree of proficiency and skill. It then stimulates them even further to excellence beyond their campaign, if it's so desired. Here's the complete Game Master experience, including chapters on: - Preparing for the Principal Role - The Master Milieu: Design and Maintenance - Mastery and Modification of the Rules and Systems - How to Master the Adventure Scenario - Why a Campaign Fails - How to Establish and Manage an RPG Convention - How to Create Your Own RPG Publication - How to Assist Others toward Master Game Mastering For present and aspiring Game Masters, Master of the Game is the long-awaited companion to Gary Gygax's previous successful book, Role Playing Mastery. It's a guide no Game Master should be without.

Name: GAELCON-89 MegaTraveller Role-Playing Competition
Description: From the introduction: Thuneche is a planet in the player's sector that for many a year was criminally mismanaged by the corrupt rulers. The Imperial Navy has had to intervene in a humanitarian gesture supported by the populace. There is currently battling widespread famine, disease, and poverty. However, spurred by a recent film made showing the scenes of tragedy, "Peace Relief", the heart of the sub-sector has gone out to Thuneche and relief aid is pouring in. The players are a group of doctors escorting a shipment of medical supplies to the plague stricken world. By Imperial Naval law, any ship travelling any segment of the journey must give priority passage if such is available. They first segment from Caw to Locksure was pretty bad, being on a tramp freighter, "The Drunken Harlot". To make up for it their administrative leader Wanda Womyan argued especially hard with a Luxury Liner, The Star Queene, convincing its chief steward that things could be made bad for Arnelia Lines if they were refused. Unfortunately because of the short connection time, most of their personal baggage was lost although the supplies were transferred. They drug for jump as usual and the scenario begins when they regain consciousness on the morning of Oneday.

Name: The DM's Book of Nasty Tricks and Misfit Magic
Description: From the introduction: Welcome, my fellow DM's. Are your players getting around the evil traps set for them? Is your campaign becoming dull, as monsters are obliterated and players cart enough gold out of your dungeon to pave streets with it? Are they killing those hard-created monsters of yours? Are they trashing a week's hard campaign management and design in an our, and then looking for more? Fear no more. The DM's Book of Nasty Tricks & Misfit Magics is a hellish compendium of ideas, tricks, traps, and specially designed material to help any fantasy campaign. This book is a DM's guide to monstrous ideas that will liven any game, as you put the fear of death back into your players. Along with new ideas are many useful tables and charts that can add random events to liven your campaign. The rear of the book is a new idea called Fantasy Real Estate, page of places for sale that your adventurers can buy to call home.

Name: Marxmen 12.35
Description: Marxmen 12.35 is the only sourcebook released for Berlin XVIII second edition. Inside, you'll find: - a chronology of events happening between 2066 and 2089 - a description of Australis, the Australian mining space station - 2 scenarios ("Bonnes bavures & modes majeurs" and "Psychose") - new rules for weapons and vehicles - new weapons, cars, trucks... - several short stories and a 5-pages comic

Name: De svarta banden
Description: User summary Adventure for Western 2nd edition. Taking place close to the border between Arizona and New Mexico in the year 1871. The plot revolves around the hunt for a bandit gangs hidden loot. Producers summary (In swedish) Tre män rånar en bank i New Mexico. De kommer undan med bytet, men börjar bråka inbördes. Slutligen dödar de två underhuggarna Pete Clanton och Joe Blake ledaren i gänget. De gömmer pengarna i en gammal Navajo mesa och beslutar sig för att dra sig tillbaka till anonymiteten. De återvänder till sina familjer och arbeten i en vanlig småstad i västern. Clanton och Blake bestämmer sig också för att försäkra sig om att deras fruar skall få pengarna från bankrånet om de skulle dö. De graverar därför varsin halva av kartan över mesan på sina revolverkolvar. Det visar sig att ledaren, Charles Brent, som de trodde sig ha dödat överlevde och nu leder en brutal och ökänd rånarliga som kallar sig "De Svarta Banden". Brent söker de två förrädarna för att ta tillbaka bytet. De Svarta Banden lyckas få tag på Clanton och skjuter ner honom. Emellertid lyckas den döende mannen kravla undan och in i rollpersonernas läger. Han ger dem sin revolver och ber rollpersonerna se till att hans fru får en del av de gömda pengarna, därefter dör han. Kommer rollpersonerna få tag på den andra revolvern före De Svarta Banden och kommer de att få tag på bytet?

Name: U.S.A.: What is the Great American Invention?
Description: Publisher's blurb: As an Earth Inspector, the reader tries to uncover the mystery of the great American invention.

Name: Hogan's Last Stop
Description: User summary Adventure for Western 2nd edition. Played in and around a Hogan's Last Stop, a small sawmill town in New Mexico controlled by a bandit gang. Producers summary (In swedish) Rollpersonerna blir vittnen till ett oerhört grymt diligensöverfall och märker att förövarna försöker få det att se ut som ett indianöverfall. Rånet utfördes i själva verket av ett banditgäng vars ledare, David Farley, vill hämnas på alla som satt i den jury som dömde hans bror Roscoe till döden. En av dessa jurymedlemmar var med på diligensen. När banditerna inser att rollpersonerna bevittnat alltihop och vet att "Indianöverfallet" bara var en täckmantel försöker de sätta dit rollpersonerna för mordet på en vicesheriff i en närbelägen stad. Rollpersonerna hamnar i stora problem och har inget annat val än att försöka bekämpa banditgänget. Samtidigt närmar sig hämndsagan sitt sista kapitel; mordet på den nu pensionerade domaren från rättegången, Damien Moon, som nu bor i området. Kommer rollpersonerna att lyckas genomskåda banditernas plan och rädda domare Moon i tid?

Name: Return of the Ninja
Description: From the Back of the BookCan you settle an ancient family feud? Your friend Nada teaches martial arts at a school called a dojo in the mountains of Japan. When she goes away to take care of some family business, she leaves you in charge. But when Nada does not return, you must decide whether to get involved in a ninja family feud that could whirl you back a thousand years into the past. User NotesThe 1989 English Soft Cover lacks About the Author and About the Illustrator back matter, which is unusual for the series during that printing run.

Name: Stock Car Champion
Description: From publisher blurb: The reader most choose between being a mechanic for a winning driver, or opting to be a driver that competes!

Name: The Hidden Blueprints Game
Description: Book 2 of the Biggles Adventure Games series. (from the cover) Exciting new adventure game. Mysteries to Solve. Maps to follow. Codes to crack. Another title in the Adventure Game Book series and based on W.E.Johns' characters, in this story Biggles and his team go on a secret mission.

Name: Omnigon: The Alien Analog
Description: Additional aliens, equipment, and abilities for the game Omnigon.

Name: European Entertainment
Description: This add-on for Les Divisions de l'Ombre contains: - a 4-panel gamemaster screen - a 64 pages booklet describing European Entertainment, an entertainment megacorporation. It describes sports, TV game shows (all suitably violent)... There are also erratas for the game rules and 2 scenarios.

Name: The Rings of Allion
Description: The Rings of Allion was a direct sequel to FIST Adventure 1: Castle Mammon, and play occurred in another portion of the dungeon of the same castle. It was also advertised as F.I.S.T.2.

Name: Il Segreto degli Albelis
Description: From the introduction: On a late, stormy afternoon you come to the outskirts of the small village of Askgart. The wind carries the pungent smell of salt and the rhythmic noise of the surf. You are at the crossroads, waiting for the mysterious person who asked for your immediate help. User summary: This scenario was played in the first Italian National Dungeons & Dragons Championship Tournament in November 1988. The scenario is written for AD&D but includes conversion rules for Kata Kumbas, Uno Sguardo nel Buio, and I Signori del Caos.

Name: Web Wars
Description: From the back cover: In spite of the progress made by Orion agents in the past, the small Carribbean republic of San Cristobal is still in peril. Political intrigues are boiling up within the country while ouside powers continue exporting their own brands of trouble to the tiny island. While the duly elected president struggles to solve his country's problems, the deposed dictator quietly plots his return. A renewed military government would be a disaster for both Orion and the island itself. Any sort of armed uprising, whether successful or not, would halt the influx of tourists so crucial to San Cristobal's economy. The agents on the scene must uproot any potential coup before it gets the chance to begin. But forces far more powerful and devious are playing for much higher stakes than control of a minor Carribbean island. Unless checked, the balance of world power could be drastically upset and thousands of lives jeopardized. It's business as usual in San Cristobal.

Name: Westhedge Manifesto
Description: From the introduction: For use with Ironhedge Role Playing System Fun - Concise Westhedge Rulebook Plus: 12 Character Cards & 6 Encounter Cards ... Play Tested 8 Years ... Ages 1 & Up ... Old West Adventure ... Old West Role Playing Supplement Westhedge Manifesto Game of Gunfights, Saloon Brawls, Robberies, Greed, & Lawlessness (not for Morons) ... "plus BLACKWORLD FRONTIER" User summary: Published Marne, MI, USA; $7.00 - includes cardstock-cover rulebook, 12 character cards, and 6 encounter cards

Name: Captive!
Description: From the back cover: Rome, A.D. 1296. While in the service of Count Renzo, you are awakened one night by a soldier bringing terrible news- the count has been kidnapped! You track the kidnappers to an ancient monastery in the mountains, where they are holding the count captive. On your jouney you meet a mysterious stranger named Cipango. He offers to help you rescue the count tonight, but can you trust him? What happens next in the story? It all depends on the choices you make. How does the story end? Only you can find out! And the best part is that you can keep rereading until you've had not one but many incredibly daring experiences!

Name: Sieben kamen nach Corrinis
Description: (User summary) Secret societies, smugglers and murder all feature prominently in the two Midgard adventures included in this volume. Aside from Heinrich Glumpler's Sieben kamen nach Corrinis, the book also includes Rainer Nagel's Das zweite Gesicht. Both are set in the city of Corrinis, and require a combination of detective work, social skills, and combat.

Name: Zauberharfen und Runenschwerter
Description: Zauberharfen und Runenschwerter (Magic Harps and Rune Swords) is a system and setting independent sourcebook detailing 49 strange and curious magical artifacts.

Name: Der König soll sterben
Description: Der König soll sterben (The King Shall Die) contains two adventures for characters of levels 1 and 2. The first adventure is a classic dungeon run leading the characters into a forgotten temple. The second is a murder mystery in which the characters are suspected of murdering the king and have to find the actual murderer.

Name: Wares Blade Expansion Set 1
Description: Expansion boxed set includes an added Rule Book (includes character professions, advanced rules, more mecha information and additional spells), the Western World Guide (with more information on the campaign area, NPCs, and additional monsters that could be found there), and a map of the campaign area.

Name: Het Symbool van Crann
Description: From the back cover (translated from Dutch): The mists around Dor were gray when Crann and Illis-Thrann tried to measure their powers with the dark Rothin and his legions of light-fearing allies. Great was the joy when both magicians succeeded in defeating their enemies. This was an old battle, and memories forgotten, but after many years, the name of Crann was rediscovered. This master-magician is said to have trusted his knowledge to a scroll, hidden in a secret place. When an old bounty-hunter claims to have found the grave of Crann, and subsequently disappears in mysterious circumstances, all hell breaks loose. Are the powers of Darkness looking for the Symbol of Crann? Or is all this only a fairy-tale? Our heroes will try to track down this scroll, but will they succeed in keeping it from the dark forces? The future of Dor lies in their hands ... This book is a first adventure for Schimmen en Schaduwen, and was designed for starting players and gamesmasters. It is the task of the gamesmaster to guide his players through this adventure. We wish you many exciting evenings with 'Het Symbool van Crann'.

Name: Charakterwerk
Description: The Charakterwerk (character volume) contains the character creation rules of Mächte, Mythen, Moddermonster. The largest part of the book is dedicated to the 30 character classes and their powers and spells. In addition to the Charakterwerk, you also need the Regelwerk (rules volume) to play.

Name: MicroCiv
Description: City was a live action role-playing game the designer created at the age of 9 that was played from 1989 to 1996. It involved kids of the neighborhood creating and managing their own governments and economies however they saw fit. The result was a grand strategy game involving business, war, industry, crime, and complex social dynamics. In 2023 the game was brought back under the name MicroCiv with a new contemporary ruleset.

Name: Aventures pour Animonde
Description: From the introduction (translated from french): "This extension includes several scenarios for Animonde, with one thing in common: they allow playing only one person. This way of playing is quite different from playing a party group."

Name: Torshem
Description: From the back of the book (in Swedish): Modulen Torsheim beskriver ytterligare ett område i Ereb Altor – äventyrens kontinent. Här finns detaljerade beskrivingar av de barbariska skogarna rundt staden Torsborg, dess monster, skatter och invånare. Här kan du läsa om skogarnas barbarer, nybyggare, om de platser där äventyren väntar, om de gudar och hjältar som dyrkas, om de skräckinjagande svarkfalk och odöda som alla fruktar och mycket annat. User translation: Title: Torshem - The Barbarian Woods The Torsheim module describes another region of Ereb Altor – continent of adventure. In this book you will find detailed descriptions of the barbaric woods around the city of Torsborg; the monsters in it; treasures to be found here and its inhabitants. Here you can read about the wood's barbarians; settlers; about the places where adventure is to be found; about the gods and heroes that are worshipped here; the horrible black people and undead that is feared by all, and much more.

Name: Lawster's Lode
Description: User summary Adventure for Western 2nd edition. The year is 1870 and the location is the mining communities Lawster's Lode and Rico Silver in Arizona, there the silver as attracted the lawless. Producers summary (In swedish) En ung kontorist, Edward Stapling, vid ett litet gruvkontor övertalar en gruvarbetare, Creb Tallman, att hjälpa honom stjäla silver från deras gemensamma arbetsgivare. Tallman börjar dock umgås med ett gäng skumma typer och Stapling blir paranoid och tror att de planerar att lura honom på hans andel. Därför gömmer Edward Stapling det stulna silvret. Creb Tallman anländer till mötesplatsen, den nyligen övergivna gruvstaden Rico Silver, med sina nya kamrater utan att hitta något spår av vare sig silvret eller kontoristen. Ilskna, förvirrade och frustrerade förhör och mördar de den enda kvarvarande familjen, i ett försök att få reda på var silvret och kontoristen tagit vägen. Under tiden blir Stapling orolig över vad som hänt, eftersom dottern i den mördade familjen var hans fästmö och hon skulle ha mött honom i en närliggande stad. Han vågar inte ge sig iväg för att undersöka vad som hänt och hämta silvret ensam, så han hyr rollpersonerna som livvakter. Till rollpersonerna säger han bara att han vill bege sig till den övergivna gruvstaden för att undersöka vad som hänt med fästmön, och när de väl kommit fram får rollpersonerna ingen chans att ta det lugnt. Banditgänget är dem på spåren och kommer inte att vila förrän de fått tag på mannen som lurade dem på en förmögenhet i silver

Name: EsperAgents
Description: EsperAgents provides background information and alternative rules to allow play in a genre of psychic espionage and supernatural investigation. While the supplement was intended for use with To Challenge Tomorrow, much of the information provided is generic and could be used in any similar game.

Name: RAPIER - Haltiaroolipeli
Description: Translated from the introduction: RAPIER is a pointy sword, which is nibble and light and thus a very suitable weapon prescisely for elves. RAPIER is role-adventure-game, in which the events occur in the Elven Kingdom of Ilanador on the continent named Tanar. RAPIER is fantasy roleplaying game. It doesn't try to simulate real life of the middle ages and it's combat rules are not meant for students of medieval martial arts. The goal has been to make easily learned, fluently playable, interesting and perfectible game, which suits both beginners and a bit more advanced players. In RAPIER the Game master has more responsibility than in some other well known games. This is intentional prescisely to make the game more free and genuine and not just a fat collection of rules and tables. In RAPIER your character can try to do whatever comes to mind, without needing a pre-purchased "skill". Whatever your character tries to do, the solution is Game master's announced success percentage and your dice role. You can format your character into exactly the shape you want, without any confining profession or class restrictions. Not even a fantasy worl needs to be filled with stereotypical wizards, thiefsand knights. Normal adventurer can develop him/herself in to what ever direction wished and acquire the skills they want. Introduction in finnish: RAPIER tarkoittaa pistomiekkaa eri säilää, joka näppäryytensä ja keveytensä ansiosta on erinomaisen sopiva ase juuri haltijoille. RAPIER on rooliseikkailupeli, jonka tapahtumat ja seikkailut sijoittuvat Ilanadorin Haltiavaltakuntaan Tanarin mentereelle. RAPIER on fantasiaroolipeli. Se ei pyri simuloimaan aitoa keskiaikaista elämänmenoa eivätkä sen taistelusäännöt ole tarkoitettu keskiaikaisten taistelutapojen tutkijoille. Päämääränä on ollut tehdä helposti opittava, sujuvasti pelattava, mielenkiintoinen ja kehittämiskelpoinen peli, joka sopii sekä vasta-alkajille että jo hieman enemmän pelanneille. RAPIERissa vastuuta Pelinjohtajalla on enemmän kuin joissakin tunnetuissa roolipeleissä. Tämä on tarkoituksellista juuri siksi, että peli on tällöin vapaampaa ja aidompaa, eikä vain paksu kokoelma sääntöpykäliä ja taulukoita. RAPIERissa voi hahmosi koettaa tehdä mitä mieleen juolahtaa ilman, että sillä täytyy olla etukäteen hankittu "taito" halutussa toiminnassa. Mitä tahansa hahmosi koettaakin tehdä, ratkaisu on Pelinjohtajan ilmoittama onnistumisprosentti ja sinunn nopanheittosi yhdistelmä. Pelihahmosi saat muodostaa juuri haluamaksesi, ilman mitään ahtaita ammatti- tai luokkarajoja. Eihän fantasiamaailmankaan tarvitse olla täynnä stereotyypisiä velhoja, varkaita ja ritareita. Normaali seikkailija voi kehittää itseään toivomaansa suuntaan ja hankkia niitä taitoja, joita itse haluaa.

Name: Ægoor
Description: From the frontcover of the book (in Swedish): Ægoor - Träsket En av Khelataars mest sägenomspunna platser där det beryktade träskfolket härskar. Djupt inne i Ægoors mörka djungler finns fortfarande många outforskade mysterier för dig att lösa, men kom ihåg att i träsket kliver du bara fel en gång... Translation: Ægoor - The Swamp One of Khelataar's most legendary places where the notorious swamp people rule. Deep in the dark jungles of Ægoor there still are many uncharted mysteries to solve, but remember in the swamp you only step wrong once...

Name: Koor-Maniar
Description: Koor-Maniar is a universal/generic fantasy scenario intended to be used with any game system and placed in any fantasy setting. A simple game system is also included.

Name: Rascals, Rogues, Rapscallions, and Renegades
Description: Encounter tables for use with the Pandora's Dice Wheel product, allowing for generation of random villainous NPCs for use with any fantasy RPG. Introduced at a "Bulldog" Comic Con in Dallas, Texas in 1989, as a companion to the Pandora's Dice Wheel.

Name: IFGS Fantasy Rules (Revised 6th Edition)
Description: From the back cover of the revised sixth edition: "The International Fantasy Gaming Society (IFGS) is a non-profit organization created to design and run live-scale, SAFE outdoor fantasy games. Our system includes eight character classes and has mechanisms for fighting (with mock, padded weapons) and for casting spells. This book contains the rules for fantasy games, along with information about how to contact the IFGS and design your own games. We invite you to join us in an exciting organization devoted to fantasy gaming!"

Name: L'Ecran
Description: This is the GM screen for Athanor. It includes a 12 page adventure called "Les Rêves de Merlin".

Name: Ecran (Warhammer le Jeu de Rôle Fantastique)
Description: Jeux Descartes (the French publisher of the first edition of Warhammer FRP) published their own gamemaster screen for the game. The packaging included only the screen and no extra material. The players' side was illustrated with the covers of Empire in Flames, Warhammer City, Something Rotten in Kislev and The Restless Dead.

Name: Wolf's Dragoons
Description: From the back of the book: No mercenary regiment is more well known, nor as universally respected. Indeed, other units of the Inner Sphere validate their prowess by surviving an encounter with the Dragoons. This ComStar document is the most accurate, up-to-date assemblage of information ever compiled about the Dragoons. Their history, organization, and unique membership are exposed in great detail. Find out the who, what, where, when, and why(s) of the most powerful regiment in the Inner Sphere today.

Name: La Vedette Armoricaine
Description: 'The Bright Bard' (a wordplay Hellebarde = halberd) This is not a normal Asterix comic. In this comic you play the hero Grautvornix and you have to decide which way the adventure will take! A solo adventure in the world of Asterix. Everything you need is included.

Name: Dragonlance: Time of the Dragon
Description: This is Dragonlance item 1050, Time of the Dragons for AD&D 2nd edition. ISBN: 0-88038-773-4. From Drive Through RPG: When the true gods punished Istar by wreaking the Cataclysm on Krynn, a shower of meteors pounded the continent of Ansalon. Halfway around the world, a similar continent was shattered by a single, enormous meteor. Thousands of square miles of land disappeared beneath a smoking sea of magma, which boiled up from beneath the planet's crust. Mountain ranges were toppled, rivers changed course, and weather patterns were altered. Survivors were scattered and isolated. The devastation was nearly complete. Centuries later, the cultures and societies which rise out of the ruins are uniquely shaped by this savage environment. The minotaurs with their eloquent diplomats, elite legions, and gladiatorial contests, are spreading their influence throughout the hemisphere. Wild elves fight territorial wars with humans, kender, and gnomes. Fearsome fire minions rampage around the coasts of the lava ocean while the Followers of Hith seek to dominate the land. Time of the Dragon includes two information-packed books totaling 160 pages, four full-color maps, and 24 individual color plates showing maps, NPCs, and major races.

Name: The Temple of Andar
Description: From the front cover: Pirates have been raiding local shipping, but not just ant pirates. These are different, cunning and dangerous, and definitely not human! Only a handful of survivors have lived to tell the tale of these attacks - a tale filled with horror. After being contracted to investigate and put a stop to the acts of piracy, you discover the Temple. You soon realize this is much more than you can handle by yourself - but by then it is too late! A Fantasy Role-Playing Adventure for Character Levels 5-7.

Name: Dödens väg
Description: From the back of the book (Swedish): "Trehundra år har gått sedan Tatarus skräckvälde i Lamanien fick ett blodigt slut. Den fruktade ärkemagikern hade med hjälp av sitt förhäxade svärd lett en plundrande svartfolksarmé genom landet, och hejdats först då Lamaniens mäktigaste trollkarlar hade lyckats smida ett lika kraftfullt svärd, ägnat åt godheten. Med detta svärd i handen hade hjälten Matiros utmanat den onde häxmästaren på ett envig intill döden..." Google Translation "Three hundred years have passed since the Tartarus reign of terror of the Lamanites had a bloody end. The dreaded arch-magician was using his enchanted sword, led a marauding black people's army through the country, and halted only when the Lamanites powerful sorcerers had managed to forge an equally powerful sword, devoted to goodness . With this sword in his hand was the hero Matiros challenged the evil Witch-king in a duel to the death ... "

Name: Expanded Rules: Game Master's Text
Description: Back Cover: The Game Master's Text supplement includes: An introduction to Game Mastering General GMing rules A gaming sample Rules & Reasons section Aliens (Encyclopedia Galactica's Field Guide to the Known Races) Psychics system High technology rules Animal tables Planet generation Planets (entire Western Spiral system) User Comment: Other than the personal copies of the designers and artist, only one copy of this book is known to exist. This is due to the book printer refusing to release the book, which subsequently resulted in the demise of D&R Game Design. It is assumed that all other copies were destroyed.

Name: Steppelords of Mars
Description: From back cover: A sourcebook of the Nepenthes-Thoth Steppe, a region of vital importance to the continued survival of the British colony on Mars. Has information on the history, geography, political divisions and animal life of the Steppes. Also contains background on the Riders of Nepenthes-Thoth. Finally has an adventure set on the Steppes.

Name: Domination
Description: From the book: Domination is a Role Playing Game where the players assume the roles of individuals involved in the on-going war against the alien Kalotions and their allies. At risk is the fate of mankind and Earth.

Name: 10.000$ Reward
Description: Publisher's blurb: Dommage etranger... Effacez vos souvenirs d'enfance, les gentils Cow - Boys n'ont jamais existé. L'ouest sauvage est à vous mais n'oubliez pas que pour une poignée de dollards les coyotes égorgent sans pitié.

Name: You Are a Superstar
Description: From publisher blurb: The reader has always been pretty good in sports but nothing special. Then he or she suddenly begins doing phenomenally at everything, a doctor announces that the reader has undergone a genetic shift that has created superstar potential--at anything!

Name: Creatures from the Depths
Description: (From the back of the book) Kidnapping a princess and holding her to ransom is a risky business in the City of Salos, where the Usurper’s guards are everywhere crushing rebellion. As Edrix, Prince of Shadows, you must snatch her from the Usurper’s iron grasp and give your pursuers the slip as you flee through the uncharted world of tombs and sewers beneath the City! But which of the Creatures from the Depths is friend, and which is foe? You will need to have your wits about you, and use the book’s unique system of clues and skills, to create your own role-playing adventure, and come out of it alive...

Name: Ironworld Box Set
Description: This slip-case-over-box set included: - Ironhedge Manifesto - Codex Eternals booklet - Set of Ironworld tabbed index cards - Character cards - Encounter cards - Small GM Screen - Advertising materials

Name: Den Fremmede og Falslet
Description: Author's blurb: There has been peace in the country around Fosselfloden for several years. Life in Falslet, where Herg Væselklo, Hirna Grankvist, Friedrich der Krieger, Torstein Haraldsson, Fenja Bjarkesdottir, Appolodorus Krysalgiates and Old Bjarke "Troll Lamps" Ulfurson live, has gradually returned to the everyday routine. A routine that the honorable heroes didn't experience when they served as the area's protectors.... but that was all many years ago. One day, this routine is suddenly broken. A stranger in shredded clothes comes to the village. Before he has the opportunity to explain himself, he falls unconscious. It's impossible to shake him awake. But in the backpack of the man there is a letter that explains why this man has searched Falslet for the small group of former professional heroes.

Name: World War II Code Breaker
Description: Publisher blurb This book is a time machine. Travel back 50 years and decipher secret messages.

Name: Les Œufs de Karlatt
