The 156-page, full-colour The Norway Projekt PDF features: Complete Guide to Norway with new weapons, vehicles and equipment Epic three-part campaign featuring nine linked missions across the Norwegian front Art, maps and handouts bring this huge campaign to life with free digital map pack! Introduces a sinister new cult, the Flokk of the Allfather, plus the terrifying Spellbook of Azathoth The stakes couldn’t be higher: can your agents stop a plot to end the war in atomic horror?

Name: The Red Pill
Description: Where the Lies End, the Test Begins The shadows of Seattle stretch high into the sky—and deep into the past. When a pair of Johnsons tap the team to trace the source of a dangerous new narcotic, the trail leads straight into the ACHE: the towering husk of the old Renraku arcology, now a vertical warren of desperation, gang turf, and forgotten tech. The runners must find a way inside—whether by stealth, subterfuge, or sheer force—and navigate a maze of hostile factions and crumbling infrastructure. Somewhere within, a Renraku pharmaforge is churning out the drug. But the deeper they go, the more the mission starts to feel like a test. Because it is. The job is a setup. The Johnsons are watching. And if the runners can survive the traps, the gangs, and the truth, they might just earn more than a paycheck. It’s a trial by fire in the heart of the ACHE. And in the Sixth World, the only way out is through. SRM 2081-12 The Red Pill is for use with Shadowrun, Sixth World. - publisher blurp

Name: Best Served Cold
Description: From publisher blurb: “In the Black City, even the dead are for sale. Until they weren't.” In the heart of the Black City, the Silent Fang assassin guild hid a lucrative operation behind a wagon wash and laundry, preserving their victims in cryomantic cold storage and selling the bodies to a gnome necromancer in exchange for silver, jewels, and rare relics. Their greed proved fatal when a Lantern of Undeath was accidentally lit among the stored corpses, unleashing a ravenous undead horde that overwhelmed the guild; now the block lies eerily silent, rumored to be filled with lurking dead and abandoned riches. Best Served Cold is the second official module for FLAIL roleplaying game. A hidden assassin guild’s corpse-laundering scheme collapses into horror when a necromantic lantern awakens their frozen victims, leaving an entire city block sealed, silent, and crawling with a vengeful undead army and ill-gotten treasure.

Name: Too Hot to Handle
Description: From publisher blurb: A shipment of enchanted cheese never reached its destination. In an abandoned cluster of storage houses on the edge of town, crates stamped for delivery to Rordon Gamsay’s arcane kitchen tower have been left to fester. Heat lingers where it should not, stone sweats with melted residue, and something has begun to move among the forgotten cargo. What was meant to be carefully monitored culinary magic has spoiled into something volatile and dangerous. As the party investigates, living cheese oozes out of containment, spreading heat and chaos through the ruined plaza. The longer the situation goes unchecked, the worse the environment becomes. Too Hot to Handle is a short, high-pressure side quest focused on containment, environmental hazards, and reckless misuse of Rordon Gamsay’s experimental techniques.

Name: Artifact Zero
Description: From the back cover: TIME IS AN IMPATIENT KILLER Disappearances in rural Montana are nothing new. Thousands go missing every year. Most are teenagers. An outsize proportion are indigenous. Only a few hundred vanish altogether, never located. Those are rarely scientists. Spring, 1998. A mining company explores a Montana site with seismographs, hoping to find precious metals. Instead it finds what look to be anomalous artifacts at depths that make the readings suspicious. Summer, 1999. University researchers scanning the site find “erratics,” objects that should not be there. They dig up bolts and pieces of machinery; aviator sunglasses and a Rolex wristwatch; a skeleton with a steel surgical pin in its leg and fillings in its teeth—all buried for five million years. Fall, 1999. Researchers start vanishing. Delta Green sends the Agents to investigate. They may find deadly terrors beyond time itself. One of the most infamous scenarios in the history of Delta Green, Artifact Zero can be played with Delta Green: The Role-Playing Game or the free quickstart rules in Delta Green: Need to Know. It makes a perfect companion to the 1990s sourcebook Delta Green: The Conspiracy. Further incursions are available from Arc Dream Publishing. If your Agents are still there to face them.

Name: The Drowned Relic
Description: From publisher blurb: The small Village of Trutsmman kept a secret passed from mother to daughter until a rebellious young woman revealed it. Meanwhile, two Sahuagin women cast a powerful spell. A tsunami struck, destroying the dock, killing many workers, and sinking the village, which was later abandoned by the survivors. Now considered cursed by greed, the ruins are claimed by the Sahuagin, who seek to recover their people’s lost Relic at any cost. Welcome back, adventurer! Our adventure series continues with its seventh release! After exploring The Desolated Forsaken Reserva, we now dive into a region of salt, rock, and strange creatures! We invite you to brave the The Salty and Rocky, uncover the mysteries of the The Coral Golem, explore the The Sahuagin Cathedral for treasures and secrets. Inside this volume you will find: 4 different locations with hidden treasures, creatures and hooks; A distinct dynamic of exploration (hex 4); A brand-new creature: The Coral Golem - complete with statistics and an original illustration.

Name: Monty Python's Cocurricular Mediaeval Reenactment Programme
Description: Publisher's blurb: The extremely officially licensed Monty Python tabletop role-playing game. ... Monty Python’s Cocurricular Mediaeval Reenactment Programme is a rigorous course of study intended only for serious students of English History. It is by no means a complete and comprehensive manual for running imaginative, highly unpredictable, Mediaeval-themed role-playing games based upon the complete comedic output of Monty Python with one’s friends.

Name: Hexploration Decks & Tiles
Description: Build an unforgettable campaign setting! These decks offer inspiration through imaginative art, lists of evocative ideas, and simple sandbox/hex crawl guidelines. Plus Hex Minimap Tiles to build a map!

Name: Terry Pratchett's Discworld RPG: Adventures in Ankh-Morpork Core Rulebook
Description: The core rulebook for Adventures in Ankh-Morpork, giving you everything you need to play characters and run adventures in the Big Wahoonie. Source: Publisher Blurb

Name: The World Below (Ashcan)
Description: Publisher's blurb: The World Below provides. But you must dig. You must explore. You must map. You must build. You must defend. The World Below provides, but only to the worthy. The unworthy fall, consumed by bugs, lava, acidic fog, the vagaries of Kaos, and the World Below’s convulsing tunnels. The World Below is your home, your prison, and your alien world, containing terrible threats and wondrous discoveries.

Name: Conan: The Hyborian Age – The Roleplaying Game Core Book
Description: From the back cover: Conan: The Hyborian Age is a tabletop roleplaying game of swords and sorcery, set against a backdrop of Robert E. Howard’s Conan stories. With King Conan perched upon the throne of Aquilonia, it is time for other brave warriors to take up the mantle of adventurer, to craft their own stories, and to face unknown horrors in the darkest corners of the world. In temple and tomb, through desert and forest, threats lurk unseen, ready to slay and devour. Will you be steady of sword and steadfast of mind? Will you survive an age undreamed of? It is time to carve your own legend. This core book contains everything the Game Masters and players need to explore Conan’s world, including how to create your own character, detailed rules, an exhaustive list of possible encounters, three ready-to-play Tales, a highly detailed history of Conan’s exploits, a geography of the Hyborian world, and a treasure trove of incredible artwork. A Game Master-friendly approach, requiring minimal preparation for each adventure. Quick character creation: be battle ready in minutes, not hours. Accessible and streamlined rules, with an intuitive dice system. Visceral, fast, and empowering combat mechanics that promote a feeling of forward momentum. A gritty, brutal setting, where only the mighty can thrive. A tome for both gamers and fans of Conan literature alike.

Name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles & Other Strangeness (Redux Edition)
Description: Publisher's blurb: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles & Other Strangeness Redux Edition [is a] core rule book that collects: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles & Other Strangeness Turtles Go Hollywood Truckin' Turtles ...and has oodles of bonus material that includes tribute artwork, written tributes, the story behind the making of the RPG, and never before seen concept art. Featuring newly colored artwork...and more, all in glorious color.

Name: Marvel Multiverse Roleplaying Game Starter Set: Escape From Planet Hulk
Description: The Marvel Multiverse RPG Starter Set includes everything needed to dive into the Mulitverse and become a Super Hero! It features a condensed ruleset, a starting roster of six heroes, maps, tokens and custom dice for an easy start. The starter adventure, "Escape from Planet Hulk", thrusts you and your team into the arena by the Grandmaster to battle a cabal of super villains led by the mysterious Technomancer! Using your unique powers and abilities, you must defeat these villains, evade the rampaging Hulk, and work together to overcome obstacles that no single hero could handle alone. So gather your friends, marshal your strength and prepare for the deadliest challenge of your hero's career!

Name: Cycle of the Snake-Wolf 3: The Scales of Hyper-Visor God or The Final Voyage of the Crab King
Description: From publisher blurb: A paranoid, conspiracy laden, 296-page adventure for Levels 1-6+ for Dungeon Crawl Classics. A Town with Problems, a trek through the Woods, a crawl across The Capitol, and an endless dive into a Mega-Dungeon—chasing a man who dared to touch a God. All tied together with a [Conspiracy Die] that shrinks and grows as the world becomes more and less rational; unable to explain itself. Honestly I was reading Muster, became obsessed with Old School Essential’s dungeon creation procedures, and dove in… then Sean McCoy (Mothership) kicked off Dungeon23 and I knew I needed to release this product. It all started in the Shattered Woods—an agent, a family man, the Crab-King, was sent to visit a god. He touched He, setting off a chain reaction of events, the foretold death of a god, and his own mutagenesis. Enter Mercy of Angels, the haven in the Shattered Woods that housed the dying god and the government man gone mad. Here is the base of operations, where this adventure could start—but doesn’t need to. Everyone wants to find the Crab-King and just bring him home. To his family? To Washington? Rumours say he needs to be brought back to Washington, so maybe there? Maybe you find him? Maybe you just wandered over the Covered Bridge, but you make it to Washington, a place much more paranoid than you think it would be. You can’t trust anyone, but the food is good, and the drinks are even better. Supposedly the Salons (House Parties) are good too. Also, the Witch-Phase have emerged from the earth… I should have mentioned that earlier on the page. They’re elves with shark lineage from the pits of the earth. Dodge the People-in-Black, or don’t—they’ll just send Black Helicopters to bring you back. Don’t say alien. And, most importantly, DO NOT UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES EVER ENTER THE FACILITY. THERE IS NOTHING THERE AND IT IS DEFINITELY NOT JUST AN OFFICE BUILDING ON TOP OF A BLACK SITE ON TOP OF AN ALIEN CRASH SITE ON TOP OF A SET OF INTERDIMENSIONAL PORTALS. It is in fact a mega-dungeon. Mercy of Angels, the starting town that once housed a god. The Shattered Woods, a point crawl investigating what’s really going on in the woods. Washington, a city crawl searching for “the facility”: A mega-dungeon with 360 rooms, spanning 12 levels, with 13 factions vying for power, 6 layers of history, and at least 2 dragons. 270+ encounters — a lot of things are wandering about, eating people, firing lasers, the usual. 210+ NPCS — from healers, card game players, town mayors, bounty hunters, to a walking brain. 100+ Bestiary Entries — people-in-black, black helicopters, black cars, mutant shock troopers, holographic alien ghosts... the usual 90+ new pieces of gear — from Trinidadian food to shock rifles to all matter of reverse engineered alien technology. 40+ Vehicles — tanks, catamarans, hang gliders. 24 Mercenaries — including a strange man in a mask and a were-jackalope. 30 adventure hooks — there’s UFOs in Washington you know. 30 occupations and new character Desires to go with them. — you can be a noise musician! 1 new playable species. not including the Metal-Faced Giantess, the Giant Robot, or the Spell OS Drives scattered all about; as well as procedures for Oracle Cards, Trading Cards, and Collectible Card Games.

Name: Stormlight World Guide
Description: From publisher blurb: Your guide to the world of Roshar! Brandon Sanderson’s epic fantasy series The Stormlight Archive® is renowned for its intricate and imaginative world-building. This guide to the history, cultures, and key figures of Roshar is also the first official art book for the series! Whether you’re new to the setting or a longtime reader eager for new details, the Stormlight™ World Guide is a beautifully illustrated tome that’s packed with canonical lore. This book is also an essential resource for the Cosmere® Roleplaying Game. Together with the Stormlight™ Handbook, it contains everything you need to begin your journey in a world of adventure and Investiture! The World Guide is a must-have for tabletop roleplaying fans new to the setting and longtime readers eager for new canonical details. Contains eight chapters about the Cosmere and Roshar. Learn about the history of Roshar, important characters you may meet in your adventures, and more! Includes a detailed adversary and bestiary guide for game masters! Features over 125 illustrations from some of the best fantasy artists in the world.

Name: ALIEN: The Roleplaying Game: Core Rules Evolved Edition
Description: Topping charts and capturing hearts since its release, ALIEN The Roleplaying Game has become a fan favorite across the globe, inspiring new standards for horror and sci-fi RPGs while winning a dozen top awards over the years, including Best Game at the ENNIE Awards. Now the time has come for an evolution. The ALIEN RPG Evolved Edition expands upon the original experience and provides an updated and revised version that will feel fresh for rookie and veteran players alike. This expanded core rulebook includes new artwork, new content, and various new tools for players and Game Mothers alike, all fully compatible with previous releases. Exciting new features include: Bold new graphic design Life path character generation Revised and expanded core rules for stealth, stress and panic Reworked combat rules for armor, ammo, grenades, stuns, and spaceships New iconic weapons, ships, and locations from the hit film Alien: Romulus New rules and tools in high demand from players, including zero gravity, miniatures play support, and expanded campaign play The Tartarus Sector campaign setting Last Survivor, a robust solo mode for playing without a Game Mother --- from Back Cover

Name: Replicant Rebellion
Description: From publisher blurb: Welcome to the REPLICANT REBELLION expansion for the official BLADE RUNNER roleplaying game. An evocative cat & mouse race of provocateurs and powderkegs lit to explode, expose, and oppose the establishment, one way or another. In a neon-noir city of dazzling lights and moral contradictions, it’s you on the streets, wrestling with the hypocrisies of the justice system, the razor’s edge between reform and revenge, and the burdens of having too much to lose for a cause sacrificing it all. Yet regardless the price, the Rebellion must live on.

Name: Dragon Delves
Description: Publisher's blurb: Meet the dragons of D&D in Dragon Delves, a collection of ten dragon-themed adventures for characters level 1 through 12. Featuring artwork rendered in ten unique styles, these ready-to-play adventures include streamlined prep and quick start guides for Dungeon Masters. Delve into mysterious dungeons, explore captivating fantasy locations, and come face to face with all the chromatic and metallic dragons, each with unique temperaments, alignments, and magic. Contents: • 10 dragon-themed adventures for characters level 1 through 12, each set in a different fantasy location with a distinctive dragon lair • Unique art styles for each adventure from 10 illustrators and 7 cartographers • 3 of the 10 adventures can be run with a solo player • Gallery of dragon art from D&D's history that precedes each of the 10 adventures • Maps for each adventure, from a stolen pirate base to city ruins • Quick start guides for each adventure that summarize key plot points, key NPCs, and other essential details for Dungeon Masters to get set up quickly • Guidance on how to run each adventure individually or as part of a campaign • Stickers and 22 pre-populated maps for use on D&D Beyond with Maps, the 2D VTT

Name: Basic Roleplaying: Universal Game Engine: Quickstart
Description: Publisher's blurb: Powering some of the most influential and celebrated roleplaying games of all time, the Basic Roleplaying system is presented here as an easy-to-use, intuitive, and accessible quickstart. It is at the heart of Call of Cthulhu, RuneQuest, Pendragon, and many other popular games. This quickstart gives you an easy entry point into the Basic Roleplaying world.

Name: DC20 One Shot Collection
Description: UNRELEASED GAME This game has not been released yet, therefore some of the information above may change in the future. Until this game is released, please don't submit images for it unless given direct written permission from the publisher which must be noted in the image caption. From the Kickstarter: This will have an assortment of One-Shots of all kinds that you can run to showcase DC20 to your current group or a new group of friends.

Name: Cthulhu by Gaslight: Keepers' Guide
Description: From the back cover: UNLEASH THE HORRORS OF THE VICTORIAN NIGHT! Reveal sinister secrets, forbidden lore, and mysteries of the late 19th century at your gaming table. Cthulhu by Gaslight takes the Call of Cthulhu roleplaying game to the fog-shrouded streets of London and beyond. This book is specifically for Keepers—those who will be running the game. Inside, you'll find: Advice for bringing the late-Victorian setting to life. Villainous organizations and occult societies like the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn. New occult-based skills, spells, tomes, and rules for astral combat. Two introductory scenarios. Monsters and the Cthulhu Mythos in Gaslight Britain. Scenario seeds to help you create Gaslight stories of your own design. This book requires the core rules found in the Cthulhu by Gaslight: Investigators' Guide, available separately. Enhance your Cthulhu by Gaslight experience with the Call of Cthulhu roleplaying game and the Pulp Cthulhu supplement, both available separately.

Name: Caverns of Thracia (DCC)
Description: Publisher's blurb: A thousand-year-old dungeon mystery waiting to be solved! The end of one empire sees the birth of a new one deep within the earth. Born in the forgotten chambers and caverns of age-lost Thracia rises a formidable foe: the Minotaur King, along with his host of dog brothers, gnolls, lizardmen, and others. Some say that even Death itself lingers in the Caverns of Thracia, ready to claim any who stumble upon its unholy chapel. The secrets of Thracia are manifold, its treasures thrice that. Do you have the mettle to survive… the Caverns of Thracia? The Caverns of Thracia is a complete mega-dungeon setting that supports a full-year campaign! Takes characters from levels … 1-5 (DCC) 6 vast dungeon levels 250+ encounter areas 125+ new monsters 40+ new magic items, spells, and curses Stretch goals expand the ruins and an overland archipelago Combat, exploration, and social interaction

Name: The First Step: A Level Zero Adventure For The Stormlight RPG
Description: From publisher blurb: Step into the world of Roshar! Ordinary people must rise and become heroes in this unique adventure for the Cosmere® Roleplaying Game. The First Step™ is a “session zero” adventure in which players begin with blank character sheets. As the story progresses, each player’s choices determine the character they create—and the fate of a convoy ambushed by a vengeful Shardbearer! This adventure contains basic rules required for play, but a copy of the Stormlight™ Handbook completes the experience. The First Step can also serve as a prologue for the Stonewalkers™ adventure. This “level zero” adventure is a great starting point for the Cosmere® RPG! Create your first character in the Stormlight Campaign Setting while making important decisions during a life-threatening scenario. Includes a free download link for a solo version of the adventure!

Name: Age of Vikings: The Roleplaying Game
Description: From the back cover: Adventure in an Iceland of myth and legend! “…a land very squalid to dwell in, but noteworthy for marvels, both strange occurrences, and objects that pass belief.” —The Danish History, by Saxo Grammaticus, 12th Century Age of Vikings transports you to medieval Iceland—a vibrant land on the edge of the known world, where Vikings seek honor and fame through adventure. This book contains everything you need to both play and run Age of Vikings! Hero creation rules, including Passions, family history, and ever-important Icelandic nicknames. Rules for the Basic Roleplaying system as used in Age of Vikings, including skills, conflict resolution, and hero development. The history of mythic Iceland, covering the life of a Viking, laws and government, religion, and the wild and wondrous creatures of legend. A guide to magic: rules for combining different Norse runes to cast powerful spells, and the shamanic practice of seiður. Extensive rules for ships and seafaring, including naval combat. A full bestiary of enemies both mundane and magical, and an extensive section on the mysterious “Hidden People.” The Alþing—an introductory adventure that can be used multiple times in a campaign, and a suite of ready-to-play heroes. Includes a 17″×22″ pull-out map of Iceland. Hear the call of glory and honor, journey proud across your land free from the tyranny of kings and queens—enter the Age of Vikings!

Name: The Gods of Fire and Sky
Description: From the back cover: ALL HAIL YELM THE ONE! THOU HAST RISEN AGAIN TO BLESS US WITH THINE POWER! Cults of RuneQuest: The Gods of Fire and Sky is the player's guide to the deities of the high heavens and the flames beneath the earth. Each cult of the solar pantheon provides new visions of Glorantha, and provides mechanics for creating your RuneQuest adventurer. 13 brand new cults, including Shargash, the god of war and destruction; Lodril, the god of peasants; and the mightiest sun god, Yelm. Rules to create brand-new RuneQuest adventurers belonging to these cults, detailing the skills, passions, spirit magic, and Rune magic each cult offers. Details of the unique organization, history, and nature of each cult. Rules for how your adventurer can grow into a God-talker, Rune Priestess, or even a mighty Sun Lord. The history and genealogy of the solar pantheon, and an encyclopedia of Gloranthan celestiology. This supplement can be used with the RuneQuest core rules, or combined with other Cults of RuneQuest books to create a RuneQuest adventurer belonging to multiple cults.

Name: Downcrawl 2nd Edition
Description: From publisher blurb: Explore cursed mazes. Build stalactite cities. Get addicted to mushrooms. Welcome Down. Downcrawl is a tabletop roleplaying toolkit that helps you build and explore a weird, wondrous underworld so far from the surface that the sun and sky are only legend. Compatible with any TTRPG system, or as a complete standalone game, Downcrawl offers evocative prompts to generate new places, peoples, and encounters on the fly, and helps improvise stories of dangerous journeys, curious creatures, and strange underground empires. Revised and expanded from the original 2017 edition (a DriveThruRPG Platinum seller), Downcrawl 2E features totally revamped and improved mechanics after years of additional playtesting, new optional rules for solo or GM-less play, and an optional add-on card deck to make sparking weird underworld adventures easier than ever. Cheerful skeleton bards sing ballads on fragile lutes. Antlered children race giggling through shell-paved streets. Faceless cultists worship huge red worms, chanting behind obsidian walls. This is the Deep, Deep Down. Introduce a weird, wondrous underworld called the Deep, Deep Down to your campaign Compatible with any TTRPG system, or stands alone with a lightweight Fate-inspired ruleset (requires only d6 dice to play). A full journey system gives you rules for structuring dangerous journeys between underworld places. Gather intel before your journey to increase your odds of success, manage your Tack along the way to keep from getting Lost, and face intriguing story-based encounters (randomly assembled from hundreds of possibilities) as you travel. A communal Map tracks the realms of your underworld discovered so far, but watch out: connections are mercurial, with old passageways collapsing and new tunnels opening up after each journey. Get into mushrooms with rules for Fungal Foraging, discovering strange new mycelial species with unpredictable effects. Refine them into more potent fungal drugs, with only a slight possibility of all-consuming addiction... An extensive Session Zero chapter guides you through building a world and characters for a new Downcrawl game, step by step Inspiring Tables help you generate everything from ad-hoc story hooks to random locations to underground terrain types Play How You Like Downcrawl 2E supports a range of play styles. Play with a GM as in a traditional roleplaying campaign, explore together with no GM using the rules for Impromptu play, or explore the Down on your own via Solo mode. Rather than last-minute add-ons, the rules have been carefully designed from the beginning to work well with all three play styles. Downcrawl is designed to enable just-in-time, zero-prep generation live at the table (though GMs can still prep between sessions if they like). The moves and tables are built to help you quickly improvise new places, peoples, and encounters on the fly, either alone or together.

Name: Pestilence at Halith Vorn
Description: From publisher blurb: An Adventure for six to eight 4th-6th level characters: In the days before the rise of the Jade Empire and the rule of the serpent men, the enigmatic axolittians reigned in Halith Vorn and there built their cities amongst the reeds in the swamps and caverns below. They mastered sorcerous arts and paid homage to devils and terrifying elemental beings. In the end, their serpent men slaves rose up and rebelled against their rule, driving the axolittians into the lower caverns; there they lingered on, slowly degenerating to a primitive and base level. In turn the Jade Empire was cast into ruin, and the former slaves of the serpent men occupied parts of the once great city. Finally came the Cultists of Thul, worshipers of disease and inheritors of serpent man sorcery, enemies of civilization and the Baron in Longfelt, searching for a weapon of great power... This is an adventure of warring cults and lost civilisations. This module presents a time and exploration-focused site that can be used with existing Gunderholfen campaigns or slotted easily into any other millieu. It consists of 300+ keyed areas detailing a disease afflicted and doom-laden village under assault by corrupted, power hungry cultists; a hex-crawl region; and a main adventure site of ruined temples, tombs, a five-level dungeon and two planar complexes.

Name: Ghost in the Shell Quickstart (Arise)
Description: Revised publisher's blurb: Ghost in the Shell Arise TTRPG Quickstart drops you into Newport City in 2027, where cybernetic operatives face espionage, corruption, and the blurred lines between Ghost and Shell. Built on a customized Forged in the Dark system, this game lets you create elite Public Security Section agents, enhance them with cyberware, and dive into high-stakes missions against terrorists, rogue AIs, and cyber-enhanced enemies. This Quickstart includes: A streamlined version of the core rules Abilities, Cyber Enhancements, Natural Traits and everything you need for creating your first character A complete introductory mission (3–4 hours of play) Step into the world of Shirow Masamune’s legendary saga: experience action, intrigue, and emergent storytelling in Ghost In The Shell ARISE TTRPG. Publisher's blurb: Ghost in the Shell TTRPG drops you into Newport City in 2027, where cybernetic operatives face espionage, corruption, and the blurred lines between Ghost and Shell. Built on a customized Forged in the Dark system, this game lets you create elite Public Security Section agents, enhance them with cyberware, and dive into high-stakes missions against terrorists, rogue AIs, and cyber-enhanced enemies.

Name: Star Trek Adventures Second Edition Starter Set
Description: From publisher blurb: TO BOLDLY GO WHERE NO ONE HAS GONE BEFORE! The Star Trek™ Adventures roleplaying game takes you to the final frontier! You may travel to the edges of known space, to colonies in need, to the borders of neighboring galactic powers, or into the eye of interstellar phenomena. Explore strange new worlds, encounter fantastical alien life-forms, and engage in dramatic adventures in a detailed and immersive Galaxy. PLAY STRAIGHT OUT OF YOUR INBOX! This Starter Set PDF includes almost everything you need to begin your journey into the final frontier, including an epic campaign of three linked missions designed to challenge a brave crew of 3–7 player characters. The Star Trek Adventures Second Edition Starter Set PDF features: RULES BOOKLET: A 48-page PDF booklet providing an overview of the 2d20 game system adapted for Star Trek Adventures, for use with the included campaign. CAMPAIGN BOOKLET: A 60-page PDF booklet containing the epic, three-part campaign “Infinite Combinations,” which guides you through the rules as you play so you can begin exploring the Galaxy right away. SHIP SHEET and CHARACTER SHEETS: A PDF statistics sheet for the Constitution-class U.S.S. Challenger and seven player character sheets, with a rules reference sheet for each character. REFERENCE SHEETS: Eight rules reference sheet PDFs. PRINT AND PLAY TOKENS: Six Momentum tokens for each of six different civilizations (i.e., 36 total Momentum tokens), 36 Threat tokens, and 9 Determination tokens.

Name: Space 1889: After (5E)
Description: From publisher blurb: Everything Jules Verne could have written.... Everything H.G. Wells should have written.... Everything A. Conan Doyle thought but never published because it was too fantastic! Space 1889: After is the next iteration of Space 1889—the popular steampunk tabletop game—with new rules, new possibilities, and new stories to tell. The Victorian Age in Space 1889 was marked by astounding discoveries that opened the strange, inhabited worlds of Mars and Venus to exploration and colonization. Space 1889: After takes place ten years later, after war and disaster separated the worlds for a time. Now, adventurers must risk the perils of space to explore other worlds and fight new enemies that lurk in the ether. If you find the steampunk setting compelling, but are uncertain about learning the Empyrean ruleset, we've got you covered! Space 1889: After is available for the fifth edition of the most popular game system in the world. The converted rules for ether-fliers, sky galleons, and aerial gunboats are compatible with any space-faring 5th edition game, and the Space 1889: After setting itself is a potential destination for any spell mishap or astral plane excursion. Cannons, weird science, and boarding actions beckon!

Name: Lost Lore of Thracia
Description: From the back cover: Much lore was lost when Thracia collapsed and the bestial inhabitants invaded the Caverns below. A few scraps of ancient knowledge survived on crumbling scrolls and broken pottery overlooked in the subterranean gloom. Now, for the first time in centuries, those lost secrets are revealed. Lost Lore of Thracia collects the stretch goal-achieved content from The Caverns of Thracia crowdfunding campaign, all assembled in a single volume for our backers' convenience. You will find within these pages information on the ruined city of Thracia, the Island of Thracia, and the starry archipelago it occupies. This book also includes selective ecologies on the monstrous denizens of the caverns, as well as 17 all-new Thracia-inspired monsters to further populate your campaign. While this book is suitable for any fantasy RPG campaign and doesn't require a copy of The Caverns of Thracia to make use of it, owning a copy of that book, also published by Goodman Games, will greatly enhance your enjoyment of it.

Name: Treasure Vaults of the Twilight Dragon
Description: Publisher's blurb: At the base of the northern mountains, within the twisted ruins of a great subterranean fortress, the vicious Twilight Dragon – known to his slaves as Stallas the Great – has amassed a legendary horde of golden treasures and magical relics. From this fastness his armies of orcs, goblins, kobolds, and other monsters launch raid after raid on the civilized lands to the south. His Majesty the King, seeking to reclaim the lands his Imperial forefathers withdrew from generations ago, sees a chance to gain the loyalty of the North by defeating the draconic menace. But the dark and winding tunnels of Stallas’s treasure vaults are no place for a massed assault; such a task requires a team of specialists to infiltrate and systematically wear down the Dragon’s layered defenses. Thus, he has turned to the Adventurer’s Guild, offering the King’s seal and a commission in his army as a special reconnaissance squad tasked with defeating the dreaded foe. The reward? Fame, fortune, the favor of his Majesty – and all the treasure they can haul out of those miserable halls.

Name: Transgender Deathmatch Legend II
Description: Step into the shoes of a hard done by trans wrestler in the city of Slamchester and confront old friends, bitter rivals, violent bigots, awful doctors and more. Put the HRT in hurt, and put the hurt on anyone who tries you. You’re someone who’s been pushed around, screwed over, and badmouthed. They say you’re too much, they say you’re out of control. The world says you’re too loud and too violent. You should show them what it really means to be loud, to be violent, if they wanna knock you for being the wrong way, let them know you hit back. Transgender Deathmatch Legend II is a TTRPG beat-em-up designed for two players, using a deck of playing cards. Play out brutal street fights resolved via a trick-taking game with individuals tricks zooming in on the beat-by-beat of violence. Navigate the hyper-stylised city of Slamchester through seven dangerous hexcrawls. How does it work?One player will act as the Face, responsible for creating and playing the titular transgender deathmatch legend, while another player will act as the Promotor, who'll frame scenes, fill in the world, and take on the role of opponents for any fight. The Face moves across the hexmap and the Promotor introduces challenges, different weapons to be grabbed, allies of the Face, and a series of dangerous enemies. When a fight hex is entered the fight commences. In a fight players run through a trick taking game, with an individual trick zooming in on a singular beat of a fight. Played cards correspond to the attempted maneuvers. The four fighting styles of the game include different flavouring of moves as well as unique trump effects reflecting their individual style of attack. Will you be relying on strength and fighting spirit, technical knowhow, a desire to break all limits, or a bag of dirty tricks? Featuring: Easy to grasp and intuitively tactical rules Four Unique Fighting Styles Seven Hyperviolent Hexcrawl Scenarios Vibrant and raw photography throughout Templates and instructions for online play Alternative Rules Accommodating More Players Arcade Mode! Tag Team Turmoil! Own Transgender Deathmatch Legend in physical form!The book with be released physically soon in A4 landscape wiro-bound format. Pre-order via the BackerKit pledge management site here. Source: The Developer's Website.

Name: The Horn of the Dawn Part 1: Traces of Darkness
Description: From publisher blurb: Ambin Silfverspear stepped off the railing with a big sigh of relief. Almost a full month had she spent on the ship that had taken her from the capital city of Bastion to the obscure colony called Windheim. It felt strange to walk on solid ground once more. So this was Foamsvale? The town from which the Bastionites first settled and then conquered this godsforsaken island. There were tales in the capital almost as old as the city itself of great artifacts and magical treasure to be found here. Ancient dwarven weapons and forgotten relics. There was no better place to go to find these things, or to experience untamed wilderness, it was told. She would sleep the night here and then she would head off out into the wild. Her father would regret not naming her his heir. She would show him! The world shall know her name! Traces of Darkness is part one of the epic campaign Horn of the Dawn, set on the island of Windheim. This scenario takes the adventurers through a feared mountain pass and beyond, where they will uncover ancient secrets, treachery, and cold blooded murder. Included are also a few adventure seeds, written by guest authors Robert J Schwalb, Maria Ruthgård and Robert Jonsson. Ambin Silfverspjuuth steg av landgången och drog en suck av lättnad. Hon hade spenderat nästan en månad på skeppet som tagit henne från huvudstaden Bastion till den avlägsna och obskyra kolonin Windheim. Det kändes underligt att än en gång känna fast mark under fötterna. Så, Brusdala… Staden som bastioniterna grundlade för att ha som bas under koloniseringen av denna avkrok till ö. Det berättades sägner i huvudstaden, lika gamla som staden själv, om artefakter och magiska skatter att finna här. Uråldriga dvärgiska vapen och reliker. Det fanns ingen bättre plats att finna dylika saker, eller för att uppleva otämjd vildmark, sades det. Hon skulle övernatta här, och sedan ge sig iväg ut i ödemarken. Hennes far skulle få ångra att han inte utsett henne till sin arvinge. Hon skulle visa honom! Världen skall få veta hennes namn! Spår av mörker är del ett i den episka kampanjen Gryningshornet som utspelar sig på ön Windheim. Scenariot tar äventyrarna genom en farofylld dal, bortom vilken de kommer att finna uråldriga hemligheter, förräderi, och ond bråd död. Boken inkluderar även några äventyrsfrön, skrivna av gästförfattare Robert J Schwalb, Maria Ruthgård och Robert Jonsson.

Name: Daggerheart Quickstart Adventure
Description: From the PDF: Welcome to Daggerheart! In this quickstart adventure, you'll find the tools you need to play your first session of the game. “Marlowe Fairwind, the right-hand sorcerer of King Emeris, has gathered her most trusted allies to carry an important package to Hush, a small village within the ancient forest of Sablewood. The crate is large, heavy and sealed with magic, addressed to the Whitefire Arcanist. You’ve been given a map and a carriage, and the promise of reward upon your arrival.”

Name: Monsters & Magic of Thracia
Description: From the back of the book: Monsters & Magic of Thracia is a dual-system supplement for Dungeon Crawl Classics RPG and 5E. This book is a collection of 20+ new monsters and 10 new magic items ready to add to your game. Herein, you will find new foes to clash against, such as the monstrous aramoians or the despicable viperfolk, and additional allies to aid in your struggle against the tide of evil, such as the titanic argusians, or the fanciful dolphaun. Reward your characters with wondrous magic items, such as the furred girdle, or the Thracian steam gun. The all-new content of Monsters & Magic of Thracia is perfect to add to your Caverns of Thracia campain. Or it can be easily added to your existing home campaign featuring lost ruins in a lush jungle, or the forlorn caverns and chambers beneath. This book includes rules for the Dungeon Crawl Classics RPG and 5e rules systems.

Name: Faster, Purple Worm! Everybody Dies, Vol. 1
Description: From publisher blurb: Not All Heroic Tales End Heroically One-shot adventures for a party of 1st-level characters. Based on the TV show Faster, Purple Worm! Kill! Kill! on the D&D Adventures channel, each of these thrilling one-shot adventures is designed to give your players a wild ride on the way towards their inevitable demise. Like the rest of us, these characters are doomed to die - but that doesn’t mean they can’t have some fun along the way. Each of the fifteen stories inside this book features a group of novice adventurers who, through a series of unfortunate events, end up facing a legendary creature from the history of Dungeons & Dragons®. The dire but often hilarious tales that result contain the fun, drama and camaraderie of a classic D&D adventure, but all contained in a single game night. Every new group of 1st level adventurers dreams of a long adventuring career, full of daring victories and noble glory. But what about the ones that don’t make it? For every lucky hero there are a dozen unfortunate ones who open the wrong door, take on the wrong quest, or challenge an epic monster far beyond their abilities. Everybody Dies, Vol. 1 is your chance to live those courageously tragic lives… for an hour or two. Enjoy gorgeous artwork, maps, and handouts inside the PDF to immerse your players even deeper in their adventure.

Name: Jazirat Alburunz (Isle of Bronze)
Description: From the publishers blurb: Jazirat Alburunz is several weeks sailing from the nearest inhabited island chain to the North and over a month’s sailing from the mainland to the East. The island has long been uninhabited, the reason for its desertion unclear, some say a curse; others a disease. Now, only a lone nun tends to a monastery, with two castaways are the only humanoid occupants. Adventurer awaits intrepid explorers from the mysterious peak where a golden light can be seen, to the swamps and jungles.

Name: DC20 Monster Collection
Description: UNRELEASED GAME This game has not been released yet, therefore some of the information above may change in the future. Until this game is released, please don't submit images for it unless given direct written permission from the publisher which must be noted in the image caption. From the Kickstarter: This will have a wide range of Monsters of all types and levels that you’ll be able to build campaigns and encounters around.

Name: Gates of Krystalia - Core Rulebook
Description: The Core Rulebook of Gates of Krystalia is the main manual introducing the fantasy world of Lumina, blending an anime-inspired atmosphere with mechanics based on a standard 52-card French deck. It provides complete rules for creating hero characters, exploring the world through the capital city of Krystalia and its interdimensional Gates, and undertaking both main and side quests. It lays the foundation for locations, enemies, and items, along with combat mechanics featuring simultaneous turns, elemental abilities, and skill checks, equipping both the Deux and the players with all the tools needed to embark on their own customized adventures in the world of Lumina.

Name: Legend in the Mist Learn-to-Play Comic Book Adventure
Description: From publisher blurb: A Learn-to-Play Solo Comic Book Adventure for Legend in the Mist Step into the rustic, mist-covered mountains of the Dales and experience Legend in the Mist for the first time through this beautifully illustrated comic book adventure. Designed as a playable, learn-as-you-read story, this tutorial introduces you to the core mechanics of Legend in the Mist in the most immersive way possible.

Name: Fragments of the Floating City
Description: Lightning cleaves the sky. High above, a vast city emerges from the clouds. Is it the ancient temple-city of Mitosu? Has the Veiled Emperor returned? This starting adventure has players venturing into a ruined tower that fell from the mysterious city in the sky, crashing into the remote mountain valley of Glynmoor. Explore the charming town of Squabville, subdue the restless spirits awakened by the floating city, and discover the secrets of the fallen sky ruin. Fragments of the Floating City is an old-school compatible adventure for character levels 1-2. It’s been designed for the Worlds Without Number system but would be easily adaptable to your OSR game of choice.

Name: DC20 Advanced Guide Collection
Description: UNRELEASED GAME This game has not been released yet, therefore some of the information above may change in the future. Until this game is released, please don't submit images for it unless given direct written permission from the publisher which must be noted in the image caption. From the Kickstarter: This will have tons of tips, tricks and tools to help you create, run, and build out DC20 Sessions and Campaigns!

Name: Ashes Without Number: Free Edition
Description: From the publisher blurb: The old world burned. Whether in the glare of nuclear fire, the arson of a civil war, or the blood-sweating fever of an undead plague, everything that once made the world sane and safe has been charred to ash. Now you and your friends fight to secure the last blackened fragments of the old world, struggling with the hazards of a land turned savage and people turned worse. Whether facing bandits, zombies, flesh-eating mutants, or terrible invaders from beyond the stars, only luck and desperate courage can save you and all you love from becoming yet one more cinder smouldering on the pyre. Ashes Without Number is both a game set after the end and a toolkit to help you build the apocalypse you desire. Just as with its compatible sister-games Stars Without Number for sci-fi, Worlds Without Number for fantasy, and Cities Without Number for cyberpunk, Ashes Without Number gives you an Old School Renaissance-inspired game chassis and a vast swath of system-agnostic tools for designing tragic destruction and desperate struggles. Within its pages, you'll find... A complete OSR game system for building survivors and sending them to face the horrors of their new world, including guidance on blending other Without Number games into your play. Genre-specific support for near-future After the Fall tales of social collapse, invasion, and global disasters, Deadlands games of zombie hordes and beleagured enclaves, and Mutant Wasteland campaigns of post-nuclear adventure in lands of mutant peril and mysterious tech. Enclave rules for system-agnostic modeling of competing outposts, tribal villages, and refugee camps, all struggling to survive a world where there is never enough of anything but death. Mysterious devices and lost relics of the old world, strange tech for mutant wanderers to discover and misuse in their exploration of ancient ruins. Campaign design tools for both crisis-centered games of immediate survival in the face of total societal collapse, and exploration-centered campaigns of seeking out the old world's remnants and recovering them for your home and allies. Myriad tags and random tables for building your post-apocalyptic adventures, flavoring your mutant perils, and building interesting ruins and survivor enclaves for your PCs to encounter, all system-agnostic and built with the Sine Nomine touch.

Name: Reanimated: An RPG for the Zombie Apocalypse
Description: Publisher's blurb: Reanimated is a zombie survival sandbox game using the d8 based Key Powered System that offers a great deal of options for customizing the zombies, from the mindless shambler to some creatures that are absolute nightmare fuel.

Name: The Spires of Kuyyin
Description: From the publishers blurb: Rusted and twisted, the ruins lie half-fallen into the steep-walled, ice-laden gorge nearby. Once, nearly a century ago, an incredibly rich nobleman, Kuyyin, hired the greatest metalworkers and architects in the land to make him a vault-home: a place where he could hide away his riches and pursue whatever it is that people with that amount of money do. Picking out the top of a chimney-rock formation in a maze of natural sandstone arches in the tundric northern reaches, it truly was magnificent: metal walls jutting into the air, all spires and arches. And as perfectly defensible as possible, flanked by deep canyons and glaciers, the sandstone arches leading away easily destroyed should any armies come to take away Kuyyin’s precious gold. He named this bastion, Boccol. Kuyyin fancied himself a king, after a sort, providing his subjects, the workers needed to upkeep his citadel, the artisans hired to build the thing itself, and others looking for a place to make a new life. He brought wise men in to perform rituals to protect and multiply Kuyyin’s gold. These arts attracted the attention of an Ice Wurm, and havoc was laid on the city, casting its spires and arches across the canyons it once relied on for protection. Now, the once-mighty fortress lies in ruins, the steel and iron that once shined over the valley. now tarnished and rusty. The spires that had greeted visitors and new residents now lie fallen and twisted. The spirits of the fallen citizens of Boccol, the mages, the guards, all roam the crushed and twisted hallways, seeking that which will let them finally cross over. Creatures have made their homes in the remains. Some venture here to retrieve the mythical treasure. Few come back, and those that do speak of stranger things still.

Name: Welcome to Night Vale
Description: [Back of the Box] Enter the world of the macabre and the mundane that one of the most popular fictional podcasts calls home! The Welcome to Night Vale Roleplaying Game inviste you to explore the fictional desert town from the hit podcast that's captured listeners' imagination since 2012. The absurd and surreal join your game with Night Vale's expansive cast of characters, creatures, and phenomena. Enjoy the included five-part mystery or craft a story that leads you anywhere in Night Vale - just NOT the dog park! The Welcome to Night Vale Roleplaying Game includes: Complete rules to roleplay in the bizarre town of the hit Welcome to Night Vale podcast. The Citizens' Guide teaches basic rules and helps you create your denizen of Night Vale. The Host Guide contains everything you need to share strange and surreal adventures. The Visitor's Guide helps you find your way around the desert town of Night Vale. A five-part mystery adventure that leads characters to the Numbers Station, the Library, and more of NIght Vale's environs. 8 Dice and a Game Master's Screen provide all the needed supplies at your fingertips. 11 pre-generated characters ready to immediately start your adventures in Night Vale. Additional Threats for your citizens to encounter in the peculiar locale. Visitor's Guide: 44 pages Citizens' Guide: 76 pages Host Guide: 76 pages Adventure "The Skeleton Gorge Incident": 64 pages

Name: :OTHERSCAPE - The Mythic Cyberpunk RPG - Demo Game
Description: Publisher's blurb: [C]ontains the basic rules, three pregens, and a demo adventure! User summary: The booklet was distributed with a sheet of tracking cards (17" x 11") and three double-sided character sheet posters (17" x 11") - Genji, Unagi, and Wilson

Name: God's Light
Description: From the back cover: WHERE LIES THE LINE BETWEEN MADNESS AND EVIL? It is madness to cross the threshold. It is evil not to seek the threshold. Which do you choose? A seemingly ordinary American mass shooting draws the attention of Delta Green. The shooter left evidence that seemed to come not from some unknown place but some unknown version of reality. The investigation finds a social media app called Picky Eater. But is it more than an app? A modified OS? A firmware update? An inexplicable hardware update? Picky Eater curates your social media feed, picking and choosing experiences to suit your desires. But it may reach far deeper than that. It may reach strange places that stand on either side of the border between worlds, between realities, between madness and evil, and force your Agents to choose. Delta Green: God’s Light … makes a perfect companion to the acclaimed campaign Delta Green: God’s Teeth. User comment: One of four scenarios that expand God's Teeth. To be collected in God's Hunt omnibus hardback in 2025.

Name: The Acropolis Pyre
Description: Publisher's Blurb: The city-states of Iblydos rule an archipelago steeped in mythic power, legendary beasts, and ancient history. Yet the region suffers; the myth-speaking rites that elevate great heroes into mortal demigods are failing, with few of the hero-gods surviving to guide their people and grant magic. All of this changes when a god's death awakens a forgotten source of mythic potential, transforming the player characters into the first new hero-gods in recent memory. But what is this mythic power, and will it revitalize Iblydos or doom it entirely? The port of Bailax hosts lavish funeral games for a recently deceased hero, inviting visitors and locals alike to compete for prizes and glory. However, an ominous meteor crashes nearby and interrupts the festivities. What the adventurers find there won't just transform them into mythic hero-gods, but also will incite Bailax to violent revelry and arson. Can the new hero-gods stop the city from self-destruction? The Acropolis Pyre is a Pathfinder Adventure for four 1st-level characters. This adventure begins the Myth-Speaker Adventure Path, a three-part monthly campaign in which the player characters assume the role of regional hero-gods and have the opportunity to restore the tradition of myth-speaking to a realm inspired by Ancient Greece. This volume also includes a look at existing hero-gods of Iblydos, a gazetteer of the city of Bailax, a phoenix-blessed city of pyres, and a toolbox of new gear, spells, feats, and creatures from the mythic isles of Iblydos, from the mischievous torcheater to the magnificent pyrefowl.

Name: The Broken Palace
Description: Publisher's blurb: Delving deeper into the ruined prison, the PCs make their way through cell blocks now inhabited by subterranean monsters and undead echoes of the past, before finding themselves in what appears to be an idyllic village where the sun crosses the clouded sky each day. The clueless villagers are being preyed upon by their vampire masters and the PCs must break the spell and ascend into the Broken Palace to remove the threat of Lady Nalushae once and for all. The Broken Palace is a Pathfinder Adventure for four 4th-level characters. This adventure continues the Shades of Blood Adventure Path, a three-part monthly campaign where a group of adventurers explore a ruined ancient prison to stop a vampiric threat to cover the skies in shadow. This volume also includes a look into the faith of Zura, demon lord of vampires and cannibalism, and a toolbox of new magic items, an ancient relic that replicates the sun, and a selection of devious bloodthirsty monsters.

Name: Folk Horror: Understanding the Genre
Description: Folk Horror: Understanding the Genre is a system-neutral sourcebook that digs deep into the eerie landscapes, unsettling traditions, and creeping dread that define folk horror. It breaks down the history, themes, and storytelling techniques behind the genre, helping roleplayers shape unsettling villages, cursed bloodlines, and stories filled with superstition, isolation, and forbidden knowledge.

Name: The Garden of Flesh and Blood
Description: From the publisher blurb: The Garden of Flesh and Blood is a faerie themed wilderness adventure site with 6 sub-locations. Featuring a tricky villain, new monsters and magic items, and original dark-fantasy art. This deadly but rewarding location is the perfect addition to your wilderness encounter tables, or a great one-shot adventure. The three new custom monsters are provided with complete stats in the style of the groundbreaking ACKS II Monster Manual, so they can be used throughout a detailed sandbox campaign.

Name: Cohors Cthulhu Germania
Description: From back cover: This supplement includes a wealth of information for Cohors Cthulhu gamemasters running campaigns venturing into Germania from the Roman-occupied town of Laurium. This includes information on the many tribes of Germania, details on Herjan's Horde, an expanded Adversary roster, and 8 self-contained adventures taking place in Germania itself: Castrum Primum - detailing a lost fortress that has become a place of horror. Stars of Ill Omen - featuring an incursion of Mi-Go in the Germanic hills. The Harvest - where a tribal settlement is beset by a mysterious ailment. The Shield of Aeneas - featuring the impossible return of an ancient hero making wild claims. Anno Diaboli - where an attempt to impose a ridig calendar upon a tribal people has unforeseen consequences. Between Scylla and Charybdis - where a holy festival provides the spark to set ablaze a religious conflict. Against the Chaos Gate - where PCs enter the gladiatorial arena and eventually discover an ancient buried peril. Aurum Habet Tolosanum - featuring a risky foray sneaking into the heart of Herjan's Horde to recover gold stolen from Rome.

Name: Furious Lands and Other Dirty Jobs
Description: From publisher blurb: Furious Lands and Other Dirty Jobs is an anthology of campaigns and adventures for Brancalonia – the Spaghetti Fantasy setting for the 5E of the world’s greatest roleplaying game! This volume collects all the previously unpublished, special edition, and out of print modules for Brancalonia, officially released between 2022 and 2024. It also includes additional content unlocked during the third crowdfunding campaign for Brancalonia. This volume contains: • Furious Lands, a campaign in 4 episodes • Honor Among Knaves, a campaign in 7 episodes and 4 interludes • The Last Voyage of the Miss Fit, an adventure • We All Clubbed Each Other So Much, an adventure • The Befrothed, an adventure • Carsian And/Or, an adventure • The Devil’s Bridge, an adventure Terre Furiose e altri Sporchi Lavoretti è un’antologia di campagne e avventure di Brancalonia - l’ambientazione spaghetti fantasy per il gioco di ruolo più giocato al mondo! Questo manuale riunisce tutte i moduli inediti, speciali e fuori catalogo di Brancalonia, ufficialmente pubblicati tra il 2022 e il 2024, più dei contenuti aggiuntivi sbloccati durante la terza campagna crowdfunding del gioco. In questo volume trovate: Terre Furiose, campagna in 4 episodi L’Onore delle Canaglie, campagna in 7 episodi e 4 intermezzi L’Ultimo Viaggio della Balorda, avventura C’Eravamo Tanto Menati, avventura I Promessi Naufraghi, avventura Un Lavoretto del Carso, avventura Il Ponte del Diavolo, avventura

Name: World Tour - London
Description: London is calling—and the shadows are answering. Fresh off global acclaim and a catastrophe in Paris, the runners find themselves invited to an exclusive, high-society gala at a decadent London mansion where money, power, and secrecy flow as freely as the champagne. Beneath the glittering lights, AR-enhanced gardens, and designer suits lies something far more dangerous: a clandestine underground auction catering to the world’s richest and most corrupt elites. On the block is cutting-edge binaural signal technology—highly illegal, devastatingly powerful, and capable of reshaping minds, markets, and entire cities. As bids soar and masks slip, the runners must navigate a web of corporate intrigue, criminal middlemen, and velvet-gloved security, deciding who walks away with the tech… and who doesn’t walk away at all. Will the team play the room, crash the auction, or burn the whole operation to the ground? In London’s upper crust, every smile hides a knife—and every deal echoes through the shadows. Dress sharp. Watch your back. And never trust a polite host. - publisher blurp

Name: Shadowrun Anarchy 2.0 Core Rulebook
Description: From the publisher's website: Shadowrun: Anarchy 2.0 is the second edition of the rules-light alternative core book for the legendary Shadowrun roleplaying game. Staying true to Shadowrun’s iconic blend of near-future cyberpunk grit and arcane mysticism, Anarchy 2.0 offers a fast, cinematic approach to the Sixth World—ideal for newcomers or those who prefer narrative-first gameplay. It retains the franchise’s beloved setting rich character creation options and six-sided dice rolls while paring down detailed mechanics to spotlight storytelling and action. Shadowrun; Anarchy 2.0 is published in both English and French by Black Book Éditions, under license from Catalyst Game Labs.

Name: Hot War Second Edition
Description: From publisher blurb: London. Winter. 1963. It is a year since the Cold War went hot. This was not just a nuclear war, as darker weapons with their roots in World War II’s suffering and fringe science were deployed. Survival and re-building are all that matter now. But human nature and the breakdown of society mean that everyone has their own ambitions. Into this maelstrom steps a motley band of women and men tasked with the jobs too dirty or dangerous for anyone else. They have to deal with relationships, loves, hatred, and hidden agendas in a collapsing, ravaged, horror-strewn Britain. Revised and reimagined from the first edition that appeared in 2008, Hot War keeps everything great about this critically acclaimed RPG while bringing fresh ideas to the texts and the mechanics. When conflicts arise in the game, players create pools of ten-sided dice from attributes, traits, tools, hidden agendas, and relationships. Control (the GM) assembles a pool of dice from various thematic groups (external enemies, internal enemies, monsters, London, and Breakdown) to provide opposition. Control and the players roll their dice, and for each die that's higher than an opposing die, that side gains 1 "success". The side with the most successes wins, and can spend those successes to generate consequences that alter the characters, the story, and Control’s dice groups. Players and Control will consistently be making taut, meaningful, and challenging decisions with their dice as the game progresses and tension rises. The game mechanics reinforce the key themes of the setting: in Hot War the nuclear destruction of society is ever present in the form of 'Breakdown' and Control can use this to make the characters' lives increasingly difficult.

Name: Forjador de reyes: Tomo 2
Description: From publisher blurb: ¿Quién gobierna las Tierras Robadas? Las Tierras Robadas han sido durante mucho tiempo el dominio de bandidos y monstruos, ¡pero ya no! A tu grupo se le ha concedido una patente para explorar estas tierras vírgenes, derrotar sus peligros y construir una nueva nación. Sin embargo, no todo el mundo os acogerá como nuevos vecinos y existen poderosas fuerzas sobrenaturales que tienen sus propios planes para la región. ¿Podrás derrotar a los enemigos de tu reino y convertirlo en una de las nuevas naciones más grandes del mundo? Tomo 2: Los capítulos 9 a 11 de la Senda de aventuras Forjador de reyes original, ampliados y actualizados para su uso con la 2ª Edición de Pathfinder. Cientos de páginas de contenido nuevo que amplían la campaña para cubrir toda la gama de niveles de 1 a 20. para cubrir toda la gama de niveles de 1 a 20. Extensas reglas para construir y dirigir reinos, asentamientos y ejércitos, junto con reglas basadas en la narrativa para resolver rápidamente combates de masas.

Name: Ashes to Ashes (The Necromancer's Game)
Description: From publisher blurb: From Dust You Come and to Dust You Shall Return Far from the trade roads and walled cities of the interior lies the town of Thistlewatch, built on the bones of something older and buried. Perched between the hills and the forests of the outer frontier, Thistlewatch survives on stubbornness alone. Its fields are poor. The town is surrounded by a land once known for fertile fields, now half-swallowed by scrubland and moss-slick boulders. The forests here are twisted thickets gnarled and grown over ruins where birds do not sing and paths loop back upon themselves. Animals have gone still. Rangers whisper of sleeping deer that do not rise, of foxes curled under trees unmoving, of bears snoring beside their kills. And now, in Thistlewatch, the children are beginning to fall asleep and never wake again. It began with one. Then two. Now there are twelve, perhaps more. Healthy children, laughing and playing, who one day did not rise from their blankets. Their breathing is steady. Their hearts are strong. But nothing, neither medicine nor prayer can wake them. They sleep as if buried in a grave. Desperate, the townsfolk turned to the Temple of St. Cuthbert, the moral anchor of Thistlewatch. Sister Lenna, the priestess there, found something older buried beneath its foundations, a sealed stair, hidden under a cracked stone near the altar. And now, amid fear and famine, she begs for aid. Something lies below. Something ancient. Something that breathes the same dust that now chokes her sleeping flock. The player characters have been asked to look into what is happening. Ashes to Ashes is an adventure for The Necromancer's Game that will challenge 2–6 player characters of levels 4–8+.

Name: Marvel Rivals: Timestream Adventure
Description: From publisher blurb: The latest Marvel RPG adventure expands to the world of Marvel Rivals, from the hit video game. Get caught up within the Timestream Entanglement as the Marvel Multiverse Role-Playing Game joins forces with the hottest video game around, Marvel Rivals! Join Psylocke, Mantis, Jeff the Land Shark and many other characters as they escape from the Collector’s Museum. This adventure features a new 10-page comic and an RPG adventure that serves as a prologue to Marvel Rivals.

Name: Clockwork & Magick: Chronicles of the Steam Age Vol. 1
Description: From publisher blurb: Clockwork & Magick - Chronicles of the Steam Age is a zine dedicated to New Europe and the World of Castle Falkenstein. Within its pages you will find ideas for new adventures, details for the Victorian life and festivities, Host Characters, Magick, SteamTech and more! Vol. 1 adds the following to your Castle Falkenstein game: A Terror in the Night: a new Headline, the equivalent of Cyberpunk's Screamsheets for Castle Falkenstein Advice for the Host - suggestions and know-ho regarding combat, all-in and when to use your own cards Masks, Manners, and Music: The World of Fancy-Dress Balls in New Europe Austro-Hungarian Sky Hussars: The Peregrine ornithopters of the Austro-Hungarian Army SteamTech Wonders: Special Formulations for your game History of Late Winter Carnival Season in Europe: a short introduction to the Carnival Season Artifacts of New Europe: The Mask of Casanova, a lesser known, but potent artifact for your Sorcerer! The Restless Explorer: a ready-to-play Dramatic Character for Players The Dwarven Engineer’s Townhouse: A new location and Host Character in Paris Carnival and Easter Delights: Seasonal Sweets of the Victorian Table Anton Kolchak – The Man with the Hypnotic Gaze: a new Villain for the Host Mr. Punch – The Masked Enigma of New Europe: a new Ally (or Villain?) for the Hiost

Name: Demon-Seed of the Plant God (The Necromancer's Game)
Description: From publisher blurb: The Wilderness Is Watching. The Seed Is Stirring. Farmhome is a place where stories linger. The crows are too quiet. The goats are restless at night. And the trail beyond the village leads into fog and vine, where travelers vanish, and only bones come back. The journey will not be kind. Every hill, every cave, every fallen log may hide danger. But the road leads forward, through wet woods and broken idols, to where the earth drinks blood and something far older than gods begins to wake. The Demon-Seed of the Plant God is is an adventure for The Necromancer's Game that will challenge 2–6 player characters of levels 4–6.

Name: The Thicket
Description: From the publishers blurb: The Green Fang kobolds have existed on the fringes of the human settlements of northern Burdock’s Valley for decades, secure in the strange, thorny thicket surrounding the Broken Knob. Until recently they were content to hunt, forage, and generally avoid human contact. But reports of open assaults on merchants, caravans and travelers using the road from Gosterwick to Deepton are mounting. The formerly timid kobolds seem to have become aggressive and hostile. Why? Eusebia, the Archontean thesmothete in Gosterwick(AV AK-23), has had enough. She has quietly let it be known that she is willing to fund an expedition to cleanse the Thicket of this scourge, once and for all. It should be easy work – after all, how much trouble can kobolds pose? This product presents the first of a series of four adventures set in Burdock’s Valley, close by the megadungeon of Arden Vul, in the World of Magae. While not directly linked to Arden Vul itself, the four provide a complement to adventures set in that legendary locale. Prior purchase of the Halls of Arden Vul is not strictly necessary to run any of these modules, although full details of some of the setting is best acquired in that product. Conversely, some thematic elements, especially in BV3, will be familiar to seasoned explorers of the Halls. By and large, though, the material here is new and fresh. Each of the modules contains a complete, self-contained adventure; that said, the four are loosely linked via an optional over-arching meta-hook, such that they could easily be linked together to form a single adventure arc. The four BV adventures are as follows: BV1: The Thicket BV2: The Tomb of Kallia (including NF-1 to NF-30) BV3: The Eye of Thoth BV4: Lost Zhamandor (including NF-31+) The maps for The Thicket are available for free in the PDF The Maps of Arden Vul. (https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/307323/the-maps-of-arden-vul) You'll find them at the very end. Note: This expansion is suitable for experienced players running a low level party of adventurers, perhaps of levels 1-3. The most numerous opponents to be faced are the members of a tribe of kobolds. While kobolds are notoriously weak foes, these kobolds have several tricks up their sleeves, and arrogant 1st-level parties imagining an easy slaughter may well find themselves quickly in hot water. Following the design principles laid out in the Halls of Arden Vul, moreover, several locations in this adventure contain serious threats to low level parties. Smart players will know when to retreat, only to return with a different plan and perhaps an additional level of experience. Foretold is forewarned!

Name: Solo Play Rulebook: Alone on the Planet of the Apes
Description: From the book, Chapter 1, pg7: This book allows you to create and run adventures for yourself. The solo play rules, tables, and procedures give you all you need to play your own solo adventures from scratch, modify prewritten group play adventures for solo play, and provide a LAWGIVER with new tools for group play. It also contains three prewritten solo adventures designed to transition you through the forms of solo play covered in this book. “Murder Most Ape,” the first adventure, allows you to jump right in and start playing with minimum effort and solo knowledge (page 81). Each adventure after that utilizes more of the oracles, tables, and procedures from the rules. Together, these scenarios provide you with playable examples of any level of solo play.

Name: Hellbreakers
Description: Publisher Blurb: As the Hellfire Crisis dawns and spreads its turmoil throughout Avistan, the nation of Isger is being shaken up by the rebel organization the Hellbreakers League, which seeks to break Isger free of its oppressor and patron nation of infernal Cheliax. Player characters will carry out daring missions against Chelaxian strongholds, face off with the deadly Hellknights, and strike out against the forces of Hell itself! On the way, they’ll run into dangerous enemies both new and old and uncover long-lost secrets powerful and ancient. Can the PCs stoke the fires of revolution and throw off the diabolic chains of Cheliax or will they be ground beneath the boot of oppression? Join the Hellbreakers and do your part! For character levels 1-10.

Name: The Dark Heart Tree
Description: From publisher blurb: After crossing a series of green hills, the characters will find the Land of the Black Trees, a place abandoned by any form of human civilization. It is said that the region is plagued by hauntings, inexplicable voices, and sudden disappearances. However, much is left unsaid, for no one has returned to tell the tale. Welcome back, adventurer! Our series continues now in the depths of dense tropical forests. After venturing through #0 — The Hollow Tower in the desert sands, #1 — The Pact Flame in volcanic lands, and #2 — On the Frozen Wastelands, #3 — The Suns Betrayal, we now bring you the fifth region. We invite you to brave The Dark Forest, uncover the mysteries of the Well and the Monolith, explore the Inverted Stairs, and face the Dark Heart Tree, a terrorizing creature born by nature. The Sun’s Betrayal is an adventure for characters of levels 2–4, designed for use with Old-School Essentials. Written by Nicole Mattos • Edited by Davide Tramma and Ícaro Agostino • Original art by Geraldo Marinho Inside this volume you will find: A Hexmap of the Region, featuring four distinct locations to explore, including a mini dungeon; A new game mechanic: The Moving Trees; A brand-new creature: The Dark Heart Tree – complete with statistics and an original illustration.

Name: Glory Road Roleplay IIE - Encounters
Description: Publisher's blurb: The first beings in this book are people. They have speech, societies and most of them are bipeds. I never intended that a campaign use every kind of people listed but they are available for use, modification, or neglect. The next group of beings are the dragons, who have speech, rarely have societies, and are not bipedal. My take on dragons, that they are distinguished from one another by many things but not by their breath weapon doesn’t prevent my presenting a large variety of dragon kinds. The third group is called beasts and is a grab-bag of beings, mostly without speech or societies, differing greatly from one another. Some are real-world animals and others are from fiction and folklore. The undead, ranging from almost-harmless Voices, repeating what a person said in life, to Liches and Presences, powerful inimical beings. Then demons, both minor and major And finally, vampires.

Name: Deniable Assets
Description: Sometimes you need a ready-to-play character for a pick-up game; other times, just a spark of inspiration or a starting point to tweak and make your own. Either way, having a few pregens handy is always appreciated. So, here are 15 new pregen characters for Shadowrun Anarchy v2.0, including 2 technomancers! - publisher blurp

Name: AnamnesiA
Description: AnamnesiA is a GM-less narrative roleplaying game of psychological horror for 2–4 players. Your characters wake up with no memory of a traumatic event. Over 5 cycles of play (90–150 minutes), you piece together what happened — and what you did. THE RIGHT-HAND RULE The core mechanic: when you roll dice to recover a memory, the player sitting to your right interprets the result. Not you. You never control your own past. WHAT'S INCLUDED — 4 Archetypes: The Survivor, The Witness, The Protector, The Catalyst — 2 complete scenarios: The Incident, The Betrayal — Built-in safety tools: X-Card, Lines & Veils, Session Zero guide — Expanded Keeper Guide with phase-specific complication generators — Universal Fragment Tables for improvised play — Game variants: Custodian-less Mode, Campaign Mode, Light Thriller Mode — Free appendix: The Lethe Infection (compatible with OSE, Mörk Borg, Call of Cthulhu) Free Quickstart available on itch.io and DriveThruRPG. Designed by Riccardo Scaringi (Il Gioco in Tavolo). ZineQuest 2026.

Name: Courts & Crowns: A 5E Supplement for Court Intrigue, Romance & Social Mayhem
Description: From publisher blurb: Your sword will not help you here. You've been invited to a ball — and it's the most dangerous room you've ever walked into. No dungeon. No dragon. Just candlelight, champagne, four people already plotting something, two people desperately in love, and one person smiling at you in a way that means absolutely nothing good. Courts and Crowns is a complete 300-page social mechanics supplement for 5th Edition D&D. Inside: A full Reputation Point economy The Gossip Engine — a living rumor-and-scandal system Six new Courtly Classes: Courtier, Gossip, Herald, Paramour, Performer, Schemer Dancing, flirtation, wit duels, and kissing mechanics (yes, with a critical failure table) A Wardrobe System that will make your players think very carefully about what they wear to a coronation Court Profiles for every existing 5E class Full Season frameworks, NPCs, story hooks, and patron relationships For new players who love Bridgerton and Pride & Prejudice. For veteran players ready to watch their dragon-slaying Warrior get destroyed by a seating chart. Social encounters deserve the same mechanical weight as combat. This is the supplement that gives it to them. The Season has begun. Do try to wear the right thing.

Name: Witch: Fated Souls 2E
Description: From publisher blurb: Witch: Fated Souls Second Edition is a modern, dark fantasy game where you play a witch who sold their soul to a demon for power. Your soul might be lost, but there’s still hope for redemption if you can outwit your demon! The game draws its inspiration from TV shows like: The Chilling Adventures of Sabrina, Supernatural, and American Horror Story: Coven. Behind the familiar façade of the world you know hides a world of supernatural wonder and horror. This game deals with witches—known as Fated—people who sold their souls in a demonic bargain. The reasons witches strike such a hellish bargain are varied. One witch might fate themselves for power, another for money, and a third to save a loved one. Magic is never the point of the bargain, but it always comes as a side-effect whether the witch likes it or not. Most witches come to regret this deal sooner or later.

Name: The Crypt of Atan-Thu (C&C)
Description: From publisher blurb: Tales of Atan-Thu are told to frighten both the bold and the meek alike. Necromancer without peer. Merciless tyrant of Zahal Keep. His evil stretched across the land like a malignant shadow. Though long dead, his legend persists.
